```typescript
import { DynamoDBClient } from '@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb';
import { 
  DynamoDBDocumentClient, 
  PutCommand, 
  QueryCommand,
  BatchWriteCommand 
} from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';

export class DynamoDBEventStore implements EventStore {
  private docClient: DynamoDBDocumentClient;
  private tableName: string;
  private snapshotTable: string;

  constructor(
    tableName: string,
    snapshotTable: string,
    private eventPublisher: EventPublisher
  ) {
    const client = new DynamoDBClient({});
    this.docClient = DynamoDBDocumentClient.from(client);
    this.tableName = tableName;
    this.snapshotTable = snapshotTable;
  }

  async appendEvent(event: DomainEvent): Promise<void> {
    const envelope = {
      aggregateId: event.metadata.aggregateId,
      version: event.metadata.version,
      eventId: event.metadata.eventId,
      eventType: event.metadata.eventType,
      aggregateType: event.metadata.aggregateType,
      timestamp: event.metadata.timestamp,
      data: EventSerializer.serialize(event),
      ttl: this.calculateTTL(event.metadata.timestamp),
    };

    // Optimistic concurrency control
    const params = {
      TableName: this.tableName,
      Item: envelope,
      ConditionExpression: 'attribute_not_exists(aggregateId) AND attribute_not_exists(version)',
    };

    try {
      await this.docClient.send(new PutCommand(params));
      await this.eventPublisher.publish(event);
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.name === 'ConditionalCheckFailedException') {
        throw new Error('Concurrency conflict: event version already exists');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async appendEvents(events: DomainEvent[]): Promise<void> {
    // Batch write with transaction support
    const items = events.map(event => ({
      PutRequest: {
        Item: {
          aggregateId: event.metadata.aggregateId,
          version: event.metadata.version,
          eventId: event.metadata.eventId,
          eventType: event.metadata.eventType,
          aggregateType: event.metadata.aggregateType,
          timestamp: event.metadata.timestamp,
          data: EventSerializer.serialize(event),
          ttl: this.calculateTTL(event.metadata.timestamp),
        },
      },
    }));

    await this.docClient.send(
      new BatchWriteCommand({
        RequestItems: {
          [this.tableName]: items,
        },
      })
    );

    // Publish all events
    for (const event of events) {
      await this.eventPublisher.publish(event);
    }
  }

  async getEvents(aggregateId: string, fromVersion: number = 0): Promise<EventEnvelope[]> {
    const params = {
      TableName: this.tableName,
      KeyConditionExpression: 'aggregateId = :aggregateId AND version >= :fromVersion',
      ExpressionAttributeValues: {
        ':aggregateId': aggregateId,
        ':fromVersion': fromVersion,
      },
      ScanIndexForward: true, // Sort ascending by version
    };

    const result = await this.docClient.send(new QueryCommand(params));
    return (result.Items || []).map(item => EventSerializer.deserialize(item.data));
  }

  async getAllEvents(fromTimestamp?: string): Promise<EventEnvelope[]> {
    const params: any = {
      TableName: this.tableName,
      IndexName: 'TimestampIndex',
      ScanIndexForward: true,
    };

    if (fromTimestamp) {
      params.KeyConditionExpression = 'timestamp >= :fromTimestamp';
      params.ExpressionAttributeValues = {
        ':fromTimestamp': fromTimestamp,
      };
    }

    const result = await this.docClient.send(new QueryCommand(params));
    return (result.Items || []).map(item => EventSerializer.deserialize(item.data));
  }

  async getSnapshot(aggregateId: string): Promise<AggregateSnapshot | null> {
    const result = await this.docClient.send(
      new QueryCommand({
        TableName: this.snapshotTable,
        KeyConditionExpression: 'aggregateId = :aggregateId',
        ExpressionAttributeValues: {
          ':aggregateId': aggregateId,
        },
        ScanIndexForward: false,
        Limit: 1,
      })
    );

    return result.Items?.[0] as AggregateSnapshot || null;
  }

  async saveSnapshot(snapshot: AggregateSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    await this.docClient.send(
      new PutCommand({
        TableName: this.snapshotTable,
        Item: snapshot,
      })
    );
  }

  private calculateTTL(timestamp: string): number {
    // Keep events for 7 years (configurable)
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    date.setFullYear(date.getFullYear() + 7);
    return Math.floor(date.getTime() / 1000);
  }
}
```

```typescript
// src/schema/schema-registry.ts
export interface EventSchema {
  eventType: string;
  version: number;
  schema: any; // JSON Schema
  upcastFrom?: number;
}

export class SchemaRegistry {
  private schemas: Map<string, Map<number, EventSchema>> = new Map();

  registerSchema(schema: EventSchema): void {
    if (!this.schemas.has(schema.eventType)) {
      this.schemas.set(schema.eventType, new Map());
    }
    this.schemas.get(schema.eventType)!.set(schema.version, schema);
  }

  getSchema(eventType: string, version: number): EventSchema | undefined {
    return this.schemas.get(eventType)?.get(version);
  }

  getLatestVersion(eventType: string): number {
    const versions = this.schemas.get(eventType);
    if (!versions || versions.size === 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return Math.max(...versions.keys());
  }

  getAllVersions(eventType: string): number[] {
    const versions = this.schemas.get(eventType);
    if (!versions) {
      return [];
    }
    return Array.from(versions.keys()).sort();
  }
}

// src/schema/event-upcaster.ts
export interface Upcaster {
  upcast(event: EventEnvelope): EventEnvelope;
  canUpcast(eventType: string, fromVersion: number, toVersion: number): boolean;
}

export class EventUpcasterChain {
  private upcasters: Map<string, Upcaster[]> = new Map();

  constructor(private schemaRegistry: SchemaRegistry) {}

  registerUpcaster(eventType: string, upcaster: Upcaster): void {
    if (!this.upcasters.has(eventType)) {
      this.upcasters.set(eventType, []);
    }
    this.upcasters.get(eventType)!.push(upcaster);
  }

  upcast(event: EventEnvelope): EventEnvelope {
    const currentVersion = event.metadata.schemaVersion;
    const latestVersion = this.schemaRegistry.getLatestVersion(event.metadata.eventType);

    if (currentVersion === latestVersion) {
      return event;
    }

    let upcastedEvent = event;
    const upcasters = this.upcasters.get(event.metadata.eventType) || [];

    for (let version = currentVersion; version < latestVersion; version++) {
      const upcaster = upcasters.find(u => 
        u.canUpcast(event.metadata.eventType, version, version + 1)
      );

      if (upcaster) {
        upcastedEvent = upcaster.upcast(upcastedEvent);
      } else {
        throw new Error(
          `No upcaster found for ${event.metadata.eventType} from version ${version} to ${version + 1}`
        );
      }
    }

    return upcastedEvent;
  }
}

// Example: Account Created Event V1 -> V2 Upcaster
// src/domains/account/upcasters/account-created-v1-to-v2.upcaster.ts
export class AccountCreatedV1ToV2Upcaster implements Upcaster {
  canUpcast(eventType: string, fromVersion: number, toVersion: number): boolean {
    return eventType === 'AccountCreated' && fromVersion === 1 && toVersion === 2;

    // V1 had only: accountNumber, initialBalance, currency
    // V2 adds: ownerName, accountType, status
    return {

      metadata: {
        ...event.metadata,
        schemaVersion: 2,

      data: {
        ...event.data,
        ownerName: event.data.ownerName || 'Unknown',
        accountType: 'CHECKING', // Default value
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      },
    };
  }
}
```

// src/core/aggregate-root.ts
export abstract class AggregateRoot {
  private uncommittedEvents: DomainEvent[] = [];
  protected version: number = 0;

  constructor(public readonly id: string) {}

  protected addEvent(event: DomainEvent): void {
    this.uncommittedEvents.push(event);
    this.apply(event);
    this.version++;
  }

  abstract apply(event: DomainEvent): void;

  getUncommittedEvents(): DomainEvent[] {
    return [...this.uncommittedEvents];
  }

  markEventsAsCommitted(): void {
    this.uncommittedEvents = [];
  }

  loadFromHistory(events: EventEnvelope[]): void {
    events.forEach(envelope => {
      // Convert envelope back to domain event
      const event = this.deserializeEvent(envelope);
      this.apply(event);
      this.version = envelope.metadata.version;
    });
  }

  protected abstract deserializeEvent(envelope: EventEnvelope): DomainEvent;
}

// src/core/repository.ts
export interface Repository<T extends AggregateRoot> {
  getById(id: string): Promise<T | null>;
  save(aggregate: T): Promise<void>;
}

export class EventSourcedRepository<T extends AggregateRoot> implements Repository<T> {
  constructor(
    private eventStore: EventStore,
    private aggregateFactory: (id: string) => T,
    private snapshotInterval: number = 100,
    private upcasterChain: EventUpcasterChain
  ) {}

  async getById(id: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const aggregate = this.aggregateFactory(id);
    
    // Try to load from snapshot first
    const snapshot = await this.eventStore.getSnapshot(id);
    let fromVersion = 0;

    if (snapshot) {
      aggregate.loadFromHistory([{
        metadata: {
          eventId: '',
          eventType: 'Snapshot',
          aggregateId: id,
          aggregateType: snapshot.aggregateType,
          version: snapshot.version,
          timestamp: snapshot.timestamp,
          schemaVersion: 1,
        },
        data: snapshot.state,
      }]);
      fromVersion = snapshot.version + 1;
    }

    // Load events after snapshot
    const events = await this.eventStore.getEvents(id, fromVersion);
    
    if (events.length === 0 && !snapshot) {
      return null;
    }

    // Upcast events to latest version
    const upcastedEvents = events.map(event => this.upcasterChain.upcast(event));
    
    aggregate.loadFromHistory(upcastedEvents);
    return aggregate;
  }

  async save(aggregate: T): Promise<void> {
    const events = aggregate.getUncommittedEvents();
    
    if (events.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    await this.eventStore.appendEvents(events);
    aggregate.markEventsAsCommitted();

    // Create snapshot if needed
    if (aggregate['version'] % this.snapshotInterval === 0) {
      await this.createSnapshot(aggregate);
    }
  }

  private async createSnapshot(aggregate: T): Promise<void> {
    const snapshot: AggregateSnapshot = {
      aggregateId: aggregate.id,
      aggregateType: aggregate.constructor.name,
      version: aggregate['version'],
      state: this.serializeState(aggregate),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    await this.eventStore.saveSnapshot(snapshot);
  }

  protected serializeState(aggregate: T): any {
    // Override in subclass if needed
    return { ...aggregate };
  }
}

// src/domains/account/account.aggregate.ts
export class Account extends AggregateRoot {
  private accountNumber: string = '';
  private balance: number = 0;
  private currency: string = '';
  private ownerName: string = '';
  private status: string = '';

  constructor(id: string) {
    super(id);
  }

  static create(
    accountNumber: string,
    initialBalance: number,
    currency: string,
    ownerName: string,
    userId: string
  ): Account {
    const account = new Account(accountNumber);
    const event = new AccountCreatedEvent(
      accountNumber,
      { accountNumber, initialBalance, currency, ownerName },
      undefined,
      userId
    );
    account.addEvent(event);
    return account;
  }

  deposit(amount: number, userId: string): void {
    if (amount <= 0) {
      throw new Error('Deposit amount must be positive');
    }

    const event = new MoneyDepositedEvent(
      this.accountNumber,
      { amount, balance: this.balance + amount },
      undefined,
      userId
    );
    this.addEvent(event);
  }

  withdraw(amount: number, userId: string): void {
    if (amount <= 0) {
      throw new Error('Withdrawal amount must be positive');
    }

    if (this.balance < amount) {
      throw new Error('Insufficient funds');
    }

    const event = new MoneyWithdrawnEvent(
      this.accountNumber,
      { amount, balance: this.balance - amount },
      undefined,
      userId
    );
    this.addEvent(event);
  }

  apply(event: DomainEvent): void {
    if (event instanceof AccountCreatedEvent) {
      this.accountNumber = event.accountData.accountNumber;
      this.balance = event.accountData.initialBalance;
      this.currency = event.accountData.currency;
      this.ownerName = event.accountData.ownerName;
      this.status = 'ACTIVE';
    } else if (event instanceof MoneyDepositedEvent) {
      this.balance = event.transactionData.balance;
    } else if (event instanceof MoneyWithdrawnEvent) {
      this.balance = event.transactionData.balance;
    }
  }

  protected deserializeEvent(envelope: EventEnvelope): DomainEvent {
    switch (envelope.metadata.eventType) {
      case 'AccountCreated':
        return new AccountCreatedEvent(
          envelope.metadata.aggregateId,
          envelope.data,
          envelope.metadata.correlationId,
          envelope.metadata.userId
        );
      case 'MoneyDeposited':
        return new MoneyDepositedEvent(
          envelope.metadata.aggregateId,
          envelope.data,
          envelope.metadata.correlationId,
          envelope.metadata.userId
        );
      case 'MoneyWithdrawn':
        return new MoneyWithdrawnEvent(
          envelope.metadata.aggregateId,
          envelope.data,
          envelope.metadata.correlationId,
          envelope.metadata.userId
        );
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown event type: ${envelope.metadata.eventType}`);
    }
  }

  getBalance(): number {
    return this.balance;
  }
}

```java
// anticorruption/CatalogAntiCorruptionLayer.java
@Component
public class CatalogAntiCorruptionLayer {
    private final MonolithProductRepository monolithRepo;
    private final CatalogServiceClient newServiceClient;
    private final FeatureToggle featureToggle;
    
    /**
     * Facade that routes to either monolith or new service
     * Handles data translation between domain models
     */
    public ProductDTO getProduct(String productId) {
        if (featureToggle.isEnabled("catalog-service")) {
            // Call new microservice
            CatalogProduct catalogProduct = newServiceClient.getProduct(productId);
            return translateToLegacyModel(catalogProduct);
        } else {
            // Call monolith
            MonolithProduct product = monolithRepo.findById(productId);
            return translateMonolithModel(product);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Translation layer - prevents external model from leaking
     */
    private ProductDTO translateToLegacyModel(CatalogProduct catalogProduct) {
        return ProductDTO.builder()
```

```typescript
      'PENDING': PaymentStatus.PROCESSING
    };
```

### 2. Data Synchronization During Migration

```python
# data_sync/bidirectional_sync.py
from typing import Dict, Any
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime

class BidirectionalDataSyncronizer:
    """
    Keeps monolith and microservice data in sync during migration
    Uses change data capture (CDC) pattern
    """
    
    def __init__(self, monolith_db, microservice_db, event_bus):
        self.monolith_db = monolith_db
        self.microservice_db = microservice_db
        self.event_bus = event_bus
        self.sync_log = SyncLogRepository()
    
    async def sync_product_to_microservice(self, product_id: str):
        """Write-through: Update both systems"""
        try:
            # Read from monolith (source of truth during migration)
            product_data = await self.monolith_db.get_product(product_id)
            
            # Transform to microservice schema
            transformed_data = self.transform_product_schema(product_data)
            
            # Write to microservice
            await self.microservice_db.upsert_product(transformed_data)
            
            # Log synchronization
            await self.sync_log.record_sync(
                entity_type='product',
                entity_id=product_id,
                sync_direction='monolith_to_service',
                timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
            )
            
        except Exception as e:
            await self.handle_sync_failure(product_id, e)
    
    async def start_cdc_stream(self):
        """Listen to database changes using Debezium/similar"""
        async for change_event in self.monolith_db.change_stream():
            if change_event.table == 'products':
                await self.sync_product_to_microservice(
                    change_event.record_id
                )
    
    def transform_product_schema(self, monolith_product: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Handle schema differences between systems"""
        return {
            'product_id': monolith_product['id'],
            'title': monolith_product['name'],
            'description': monolith_product['desc'],
            'pricing': {
                'amount': float(monolith_product['price']),
                'currency': 'USD'
            },
            'inventory': {
                'quantity': monolith_product['stock'],
                'warehouse_id': monolith_product['warehouse']
            }
        }

    async def verify_data_consistency(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Periodic consistency checking"""
        monolith_count = await self.monolith_db.count_products()
        service_count = await self.microservice_db.count_products()
        
        # Sample check for data accuracy
        sample_ids = await self.monolith_db.get_random_product_ids(100)
        mismatches = []
        
        for product_id in sample_ids:
            monolith_data = await self.monolith_db.get_product(product_id)
            service_data = await self.microservice_db.get_product(product_id)
            
            if not self.data_matches(monolith_data, service_data):
                mismatches.append(product_id)
        
        return {
            'monolith_count': monolith_count,
            'service_count': service_count,
            'count_match': monolith_count == service_count,
            'sample_accuracy': (len(sample_ids) - len(mismatches)) / len(sample_ids),
            'mismatched_ids': mismatches
        }
```

```python
import asyncio
from typing import Iterator
import logging

class BulkDataMigration:
    """
    One-time bulk migration of historical data
    Runs alongside CDC sync for new changes
    """
    
    def __init__(self, source_db, target_db, batch_size=1000):
        self.source = source_db
        self.target = target_db
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    async def migrate_products(self):
        """Migrate all products in batches"""
        offset = 0
        total_migrated = 0
        
        while True:
            # Extract batch from monolith
            batch = await self.source.fetch_products(
                limit=self.batch_size,
                offset=offset
            )
            
            if not batch:
                break
            
            # Transform and load
            transformed = [self.transform_product(p) for p in batch]
            
            try:
                await self.target.bulk_insert_products(transformed)
                total_migrated += len(batch)
                self.logger.info(f"Migrated {total_migrated} products")
                
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"Failed to migrate batch at offset {offset}: {e}")
                # Implement retry logic or dead letter queue
                await self.handle_failed_batch(batch, e)
            
            offset += self.batch_size
            
            # Rate limiting to avoid overwhelming databases
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
        
        self.logger.info(f"Migration complete. Total: {total_migrated}")
        return total_migrated
    
    async def verify_migration(self) -> bool:
        """Post-migration verification"""
        source_count = await self.source.count_products()
        target_count = await self.target.count_products()
        
        if source_count != target_count:
            self.logger.error(
                f"Count mismatch: source={source_count}, target={target_count}"
            )
            return False
        
        # Checksum verification
        source_checksum = await self.source.calculate_checksum()
        target_checksum = await self.target.calculate_checksum()
        
        return source_checksum == target_checksum
```

```typescript
// gateway/strangler-router.ts
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { createProxyMiddleware } from 'http-proxy-middleware';

interface RoutingRule {
  pattern: RegExp;
  target: 'monolith' | 'microservice';
  serviceUrl?: string;
  rolloutPercentage?: number;
}

export class StranglerRouter {
  private rules: RoutingRule[] = [];
  private featureFlags: FeatureFlagService;
  
  constructor(private config: RoutingConfig) {
    this.loadRoutingRules();
  }
  
  private loadRoutingRules() {
    this.rules = [
      // Phase 1: Route catalog reads to new service
      {
        pattern: /^\/api\/products/,
        target: 'microservice',
        serviceUrl: 'http://catalog-service:8080',
        rolloutPercentage: 100
      },
      
      // Phase 2: Gradual rollout for orders
      {
        pattern: /^\/api\/orders/,
        target: 'microservice',
        serviceUrl: 'http://order-service:8080',
        rolloutPercentage: 25 // Start with 25% of traffic
      },
      
      // Default: Everything else goes to monolith
      {
        pattern: /.*/,
        target: 'monolith',
        serviceUrl: 'http://monolith:8080',
        rolloutPercentage: 100
      }
    ];
  }
  
  routeRequest(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
    const path = req.path;
    const rule = this.findMatchingRule(path);
    
    // Check if user is in rollout percentage
    if (!this.shouldRouteToTarget(req, rule)) {
      // Fallback to monolith
      return this.proxyToMonolith(req, res, next);
    }
    
    if (rule.target === 'microservice') {
      this.proxyToMicroservice(req, res, next, rule.serviceUrl!);
    } else {
      this.proxyToMonolith(req, res, next);
    }
  }
  
  private findMatchingRule(path: string): RoutingRule {
    return this.rules.find(rule => rule.pattern.test(path)) || this.rules[this.rules.length - 1];
  }
  
  private shouldRouteToTarget(req: Request, rule: RoutingRule): boolean {
    if (rule.rolloutPercentage === 100) return true;
    
    // Consistent hashing based on user ID for sticky routing
    const userId = req.headers['x-user-id'] as string;
    if (!userId) return Math.random() * 100 < rule.rolloutPercentage!;
    
    const hash = this.hashUserId(userId);
    return (hash % 100) < rule.rolloutPercentage!;
  }
  
  private proxyToMicroservice(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction, target: string) {
    const proxy = createProxyMiddleware({
      target,
      changeOrigin: true,
      pathRewrite: { '^/api': '' },
      onProxyReq: (proxyReq, req) => {
        // Add tracing headers
        proxyReq.setHeader('X-Routed-By', 'strangler-gateway');
        proxyReq.setHeader('X-Original-Path', req.path);
      },
      onError: (err, req, res) => {
        console.error('Proxy error:', err);
        // Fallback to monolith on error
        this.proxyToMonolith(req, res, next);
      }
    });
    
    proxy(req, res, next);
  }
  
  private proxyToMonolith(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
    const proxy = createProxyMiddleware({
      target: this.config.monolithUrl,
      changeOrigin: true
    });
    proxy(req, res, next);
  }
  
  private hashUserId(userId: string): number {
    // Simple hash function for consistent routing
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < userId.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + userId.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash);
  }
}
```

### 2. Rollback Strategy

```python
# rollback/rollback_manager.py
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime

class RollbackTrigger(Enum):
    ERROR_RATE_HIGH = "error_rate"
    LATENCY_HIGH = "latency"
    DATA_INCONSISTENCY = "data_consistency"
    MANUAL = "manual"

@dataclass
class RollbackDecision:
    should_rollback: bool
    trigger: RollbackTrigger
    severity: str
    message: str

class AutomatedRollbackManager:
    """
    Monitors health metrics and automatically rolls back if thresholds exceeded
    """
    
    def __init__(self, metrics_client, router, alerting):
        self.metrics = metrics_client
        self.router = router
        self.alerting = alerting
        
        # Define SLOs
        self.slos = {
            'error_rate_threshold': 0.01,  # 1%
            'p99_latency_threshold_ms': 500,
            'data_consistency_threshold': 0.99  # 99% consistency
        }
    
    async def monitor_and_decide(self, service_name: str) -> RollbackDecision:
        """Continuously monitor health metrics"""
        
        # Check error rate
        error_rate = await self.metrics.get_error_rate(
            service=service_name,
            time_window='5m'
        )
        
        if error_rate > self.slos['error_rate_threshold']:
            return RollbackDecision(
                should_rollback=True,
                trigger=RollbackTrigger.ERROR_RATE_HIGH,
                severity='critical',
                message=f"Error rate {error_rate:.2%} exceeds threshold"
            )
        
        # Check latency
        p99_latency = await self.metrics.get_percentile_latency(
            service=service_name,
            percentile=99,
            time_window='5m'
        )
        
        if p99_latency > self.slos['p99_latency_threshold_ms']:
            return RollbackDecision(
                should_rollback=True,
                trigger=RollbackTrigger.LATENCY_HIGH,
                severity='high',
                message=f"P99 latency {p99_latency}ms exceeds threshold"
            )
        
        # Check data consistency
        consistency_score = await self.check_data_consistency(service_name)
        
        if consistency_score < self.slos['data_consistency_threshold']:
            return RollbackDecision(
                should_rollback=True,
                trigger=RollbackTrigger.DATA_INCONSISTENCY,
                severity='critical',
                message=f"Data consistency {consistency_score:.2%} below threshold"
            )
        
        return RollbackDecision(
            should_rollback=False,
            trigger=None,
            severity='normal',
            message="All health checks passed"
        )
    
    async def execute_rollback(self, service_name: str, decision: RollbackDecision):
        """Perform automated rollback"""
        
        # Alert team
        await self.alerting.send_alert(
            severity=decision.severity,
            message=f"AUTO-ROLLBACK: {service_name} - {decision.message}",
            trigger=decision.trigger.value
        )
        
        # Update routing to send 100% traffic back to monolith
        await self.router.update_route(
            service=service_name,
            microservice_percentage=0,
            monolith_percentage=100
        )
        
        # Optionally scale down microservice
        await self.scale_service(service_name, replicas=1)
        
        # Log rollback event
        await self.log_rollback_event(service_name, decision)
```

```python
# privacy_layer.py
class TelemetryPrivacyFilter:
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.pii_patterns = [
            r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b',  # emails
            r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b',  # SSN
            r'api[_-]?key[_-]?[:=]\s*[\'"]?[\w-]+',  # API keys
        ]
        
    def sanitize(self, data: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Remove PII before transmission"""
        data = self.strip_pii(data)
        data = self.anonymize_identifiers(data)
        data = self.aggregate_if_needed(data)
        return data
    
    def aggregate_if_needed(self, data: Dict) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Enforce k-anonymity (k=8)"""
        if data.get('contributor_count', 0) < 8:
            # Buffer for later aggregation
            return None
        return data
```

## 4. Resource Allocation

### Sizing Framework

```python
# Resource Calculator
def calculate_allocation(request):
    complexity_score = (
        request.integration_points * 2 +
        request.new_technologies * 3 +
        request.teams_affected * 1 +
        request.compliance_requirements * 2
    )
    
    if complexity_score <= 10:
        return "small"   # 1 engineer, 2-4 weeks
    elif complexity_score <= 25:
        return "medium"  # 2 engineers, 1-2 months
    elif complexity_score <= 50:
        return "large"   # 3-4 engineers, 2-4 months
    else:
        return "epic"    # Dedicated squad, 3+ months
```

### Allocation Model

#### Small (Sprint Project)

- **Duration:** 2-4 weeks
- **Examples:** New pipeline template, dashboard, minor integration

#### Medium (Feature)
- **Engineering:** 2 engineers (lead + support)
- **Duration:** 1-2 months
- **Checkpoints:** Weekly syncs
- **Examples:** New deployment pattern, service mesh setup
- **Approval:** Engineering manager

#### Large (Initiative)
- **Engineering:** 3-4 engineers (cross-functional)
- **Product:** Dedicated PM support
- **Duration:** 2-4 months
- **Checkpoints:** Bi-weekly steering, monthly exec review
- **Examples:** Multi-region migration, new platform capability
- **Approval:** Director level

#### Epic (Strategic Program)

```typescript
// services/version-hygiene.service.ts

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { APIVersion, VersionHygieneScore } from '../models';

@Injectable()
export class VersionHygieneService {
  private readonly MAX_ACTIVE_VERSIONS = 3;
  private readonly MAX_VERSION_LIFESPAN_DAYS = 365;
  private readonly MAX_DEPRECATED_PERIOD_DAYS = 90;

  async calculateVersionHygiene(
    apiId: string,
    versions: APIVersion[]
  ): Promise<VersionHygieneScore> {
    const activeVersions = versions.filter(v => v.status === 'active');
    const deprecatedVersions = versions.filter(v => v.status === 'deprecated');
    
    const metrics = {
      activeVersions: activeVersions.length,
      versionsOverThreshold: Math.max(0, activeVersions.length - this.MAX_ACTIVE_VERSIONS),
      semanticVersioningCompliance: this.checkSemanticVersioning(versions),
      backwardCompatibilityRate: this.calculateBackwardCompatibility(versions),
      versionLifespanDays: this.calculateAverageLifespan(versions)
    };

    const violations = this.identifyViolations(metrics, deprecatedVersions);
    const score = this.calculateScore(metrics, violations);

    return { score, metrics, violations };
  }

  private checkSemanticVersioning(versions: APIVersion[]): number {
    const semverRegex = /^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[a-zA-Z0-9.]+)?(\+[a-zA-Z0-9.]+)?$/;
    const compliant = versions.filter(v => semverRegex.test(v.version)).length;
    return (compliant / versions.length) * 100;
  }

  private calculateBackwardCompatibility(versions: APIVersion[]): number {
    const nonBreaking = versions.filter(v => !v.breaking).length;
    return (nonBreaking / versions.length) * 100;
  }

  private calculateAverageLifespan(versions: APIVersion[]): number {
    const lifespans = versions
      .filter(v => v.status === 'sunset')
      .map(v => {
        const deprecationDate = v.deprecationDate || v.releaseDate;
        const sunsetDate = v.sunsetDate || new Date();
        return Math.floor((sunsetDate.getTime() - deprecationDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      });

    return lifespans.length > 0 
      ? lifespans.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / lifespans.length 
      : 0;
  }

  private identifyViolations(
    metrics: any, 
    deprecatedVersions: APIVersion[]
  ): string[] {
    const violations: string[] = [];

    if (metrics.activeVersions > this.MAX_ACTIVE_VERSIONS) {
      violations.push(
        `Too many active versions: ${metrics.activeVersions} (max: ${this.MAX_ACTIVE_VERSIONS})`
      );
    }

    if (metrics.semanticVersioningCompliance < 100) {
      violations.push(
        `Semantic versioning non-compliance: ${(100 - metrics.semanticVersioningCompliance).toFixed(1)}% of versions`
      );
    }

    deprecatedVersions.forEach(v => {
      if (!v.sunsetDate) {
        violations.push(`Version ${v.version} deprecated without sunset date`);
      } else {
        const daysSinceDeprecation = Math.floor(
          (Date.now() - (v.deprecationDate?.getTime() || 0)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
        );
        if (daysSinceDeprecation > this.MAX_DEPRECATED_PERIOD_DAYS) {
          violations.push(
            `Version ${v.version} has been deprecated for ${daysSinceDeprecation} days (max: ${this.MAX_DEPRECATED_PERIOD_DAYS})`
          );
        }
      }
    });

    return violations;
  }

  private calculateScore(metrics: any, violations: string[]): number {
    let score = 100;

    // Deduct for too many versions (10 points per extra version)
    score -= metrics.versionsOverThreshold * 10;

    // Deduct for semantic versioning non-compliance
    score -= (100 - metrics.semanticVersioningCompliance) * 0.2;

    // Deduct for breaking changes (5 points per 10% of breaking changes)
    score -= (100 - metrics.backwardCompatibilityRate) * 0.5;

    // Deduct for violations (5 points each)
    score -= violations.length * 5;

    return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
  }

  async generateVersionReport(apiId: string): Promise<object> {
    // Generate detailed version hygiene report
    return {
      summary: 'Version hygiene analysis',
      recommendations: this.generateRecommendations(apiId)
    };
  }

  private generateRecommendations(apiId: string): string[] {
    // Logic to generate actionable recommendations
    return [
      'Consider consolidating active versions',
      'Establish sunset dates for deprecated versions',
      'Enforce semantic versioning policy'
    ];
  }
}
```

```typescript
  private calculateImpactScore(
    upstream: Dependency[], 
    downstream: Dependency[]
  ): number {
    // Calculate blast radius
    const upstreamWeight = 0.3;
    const downstreamWeight = 0.7;
    
    const upstreamScore = upstream.reduce((sum, dep) => sum + dep.breakageRisk, 0);
    const downstreamScore = downstream.reduce((sum, dep) => sum + dep.breakageRisk, 0);
    
    return (upstreamScore * upstreamWeight) + (downstreamScore * downstreamWeight);
  }

  private assessRiskLevel(
    impactScore: number, 
    downstream: Dependency[]
  ): 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical' {
    const criticalConsumers = downstream.filter(d => d.criticality === 'critical').length;
    
    if (criticalConsumers > 5 || impactScore > 80) return 'critical';
    if (criticalConsumers > 2 || impactScore > 60) return 'high';
    if (criticalConsumers > 0 || impactScore > 30) return 'medium';
    return 'low';
  }

  async analyzeChangeImpact(
    apiId: string, 
    changeType: 'breaking' | 'non-breaking'
  ): Promise<ImpactAnalysis> {
    const graph = await this.buildDependencyGraph(apiId);
    
    const impactedServices = graph.downstreamConsumers.length;
    const criticalServices = graph.downstreamConsumers
      .filter(d => d.criticality === 'critical').length;
    
    const estimatedEffort = this.estimateMigrationEffort(
      graph.downstreamConsumers,
      changeType
    );

    return {
      impactedServices,
      criticalServices,
      estimatedEffort,
      recommendations: this.generateImpactRecommendations(
        changeType,
        graph.riskLevel
      ),
      blastRadius: graph.impactScore
    };
  }

  private estimateMigrationEffort(
    consumers: Dependency[],
    changeType: string
  ): string {
    const totalConsumers = consumers.length;
    
    if (changeType === 'breaking') {
      const days = totalConsumers * 2; // 2 days per consumer estimate

    }
    
    return 'Minimal effort required';

  private generateImpactRecommendations(

  ): string[] {

      recommendations.push('Provide migration tooling and documentation');

      recommendations.push('Implement feature flags for gradual rollout');
```

  private readonly STANDARD_DEPRECATION_PERIOD_DAYS = 180;

  async createDeprecationPlan(
    apiId: string,
    version: string,
    reason: string,
    customSunsetDate?: Date
  ): Promise<DeprecationPlan> {
    const announcementDate = new Date();
    const deprecationDate = new Date(announcementDate);
    deprecationDate.setDate(deprecationDate.getDate() + 30); // 30 days notice

    if (!customSunsetDate) {
      sunsetDate.setDate(
        sunsetDate.getDate() + this.STANDARD_DEPRECATION_PERIOD_DAYS
      );
    }

    // Validate minimum deprecation period
    const daysDiff = Math.floor(
      (sunsetDate.getTime() - deprecationDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
    );
    
    if (daysDiff < this.MINIMUM_DEPRECATION_PERIOD_DAYS) {
      throw new Error(
        `Deprecation period must be at least ${this.MINIMUM_DEPRECATION_PERIOD_DAYS} days`
      );
    }

# Event-Driven Data Pipelines: Comprehensive Guide

## 1. Core Design Patterns

### **Pub/Sub (Publish-Subscribe)**

```
┌─────────────┐         ┌─────────────┐
│ Publisher A │───┐     │ Subscriber 1│
└─────────────┘   │     └─────────────┘
                  │            ▲
┌─────────────┐   │     ┌──────┴──────┐
│ Publisher B │───┼────►│ Event Broker│
└─────────────┘   │     │  (Kafka/SNS)│
                  │     └──────┬──────┘
┌─────────────┐   │            ▼
│ Publisher C │───┘     ┌─────────────┐
└─────────────┘         │ Subscriber 2│
                        └─────────────┘
```

**Key Characteristics:**
- **Decoupling**: Publishers don't know subscribers
- **Scalability**: Add consumers without changing producers
- **Fan-out**: One event → multiple consumers

**Implementation Example:**
```python
# Kafka Publisher
from kafka import KafkaProducer
import json

producer = KafkaProducer(
    bootstrap_servers=['localhost:9092'],
    value_serializer=lambda v: json.dumps(v).encode('utf-8'),
    acks='all',  # Wait for all replicas
    retries=3
)

def publish_event(topic, event):
    producer.send(
        topic,
        value=event,
        key=event['entity_id'].encode('utf-8')  # Partition by key
    )
```

### **CDC (Change Data Capture)**

```
┌──────────────────┐
│   Database       │
│  (PostgreSQL)    │
└────────┬─────────┘
         │ Transaction Log
         ▼
┌────────────────────┐
│  CDC Connector     │
│  (Debezium)        │
└────────┬───────────┘
         │ Events
         ▼
┌────────────────────┐      ┌─────────────┐
│   Kafka Topic      │─────►│  Consumer 1 │
│  (database.table)  │      └─────────────┘
└────────────────────┘      ┌─────────────┐
                            │  Consumer 2 │
                            └─────────────┘
```

### **Stream Processing**

```
┌─────────────┐
│ Input Stream│
│   (Events)  │
└──────┬──────┘
       │
       ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│     Stream Processor                │
│                                     │
│  ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────────┐ │
│  │  Filter  │───►│  Transform   │ │
│  └──────────┘    └──────┬───────┘ │
│                          ▼          │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  Aggregate (Windowed)        │ │
│  │  - Tumbling: [====][====]    │ │
│  │  - Sliding:  [====]          │ │
│  │              [====]           │ │
│  │  - Session:  [==] [====]     │ │
│  └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │
└─────────────────┼───────────────────┘
                  ▼
         ┌─────────────────┐
         │  Output Stream  │
         └─────────────────┘
```

**Kafka Streams Example:**
```java
StreamsBuilder builder = new StreamsBuilder();

KStream<String, Order> orders = builder.stream("orders");

// Stateless transformations
KStream<String, EnrichedOrder> enriched = orders
    .filter((key, order) -> order.getAmount() > 100)
    .mapValues(order -> enrichOrder(order));

// Stateful aggregation with windowing
KTable<Windowed<String>, Long> revenueByCustomer = orders
    .groupBy((key, order) -> order.getCustomerId())
    .windowedBy(TimeWindows.of(Duration.ofHours(1)))
    .aggregate(
        () -> 0L,
        (key, order, aggregate) -> aggregate + order.getAmount(),
        Materialized.with(Serdes.String(), Serdes.Long())
    );

// Output
enriched.to("enriched-orders");
revenueByCustomer.toStream()
    .map((windowedKey, value) -> 
        KeyValue.pair(windowedKey.key(), value))
    .to("customer-revenue");

KafkaStreams streams = new KafkaStreams(builder.build(), config);
streams.start();
```

## 2. Schema Evolution with Registries

### **Architecture**

```
┌──────────────┐
│  Producer    │
└──────┬───────┘
       │ 1. Get schema ID
       ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Schema Registry    │
│  (Confluent/Apicurio)│
└─────────────────────┘
       │ 2. Validate schema
       ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Kafka Topic        │
│  [SchemaID+Payload]  │
└──────┬───────────────┘
       │ 3. Fetch schema
       ▼
┌──────────────┐
│  Consumer    │
└──────────────┘
```

### **Compatibility Modes**

```
BACKWARD:  New schema can read old data
  V1: {name, age}
  V2: {name, age, email?}  ✓ (added optional field)

FORWARD:   Old schema can read new data
  V1: {name, age, email?}
  V2: {name, age}  ✓ (removed optional field)

FULL:      Both backward and forward
  V1: {name, age, city?}
  V2: {name, age, state?}  ✓

TRANSITIVE: Checks against all previous versions
```

### **Avro Schema Example:**
```json
{
  "type": "record",
  "name": "Order",
  "namespace": "com.example.events",
  "fields": [
    {"name": "id", "type": "long"},
    {"name": "customer_id", "type": "long"},
    {"name": "amount", "type": "double"},
    {"name": "status", "type": "string"},
    {
      "name": "email",
      "type": ["null", "string"],
      "default": null
    },
    {
      "name": "created_at",
      "type": "long",
      "logicalType": "timestamp-millis"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Producer with Schema Registry:**
```python
from confluent_kafka import avro
from confluent_kafka.avro import AvroProducer

producer = AvroProducer({
    'bootstrap.servers': 'localhost:9092',

    'id': 1001,
```

## 3. Ordering & Idempotency

### **Ordering Guarantees**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         Kafka Topic                 │
│                                     │
│  Partition 0: [E1]─[E2]─[E3]      │
│                                     │
│  Partition 1: [E4]─[E5]            │
│                                     │
│  Partition 2: [E6]─[E7]─[E8]─[E9]  │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘

Key-based partitioning:
  hash(key) % num_partitions = partition

Same key → Same partition → Ordered
```

**Ensuring Order:**
```python
# Producer: Use consistent keys
producer.send(
    'orders',
    key=str(order.customer_id).encode(),  # Same customer → same partition
    value=order_data
)

# Consumer: Process one partition at a time
consumer = KafkaConsumer(
    'orders',
    group_id='order-processor',
    enable_auto_commit=False,
    max_poll_records=1  # Process one at a time for strict ordering
)

for message in consumer:
    process_order(message.value)
    consumer.commit()  # Commit after successful processing
```

### **Idempotency Patterns**

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Pattern 1: Unique Event IDs           │
└────────────────────────────────────────┘

Event: {id: "evt_123", data: {...}}
        │
        ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│  Processed IDs   │  Check if ID exists
│   (Redis/DB)     │  ─────────────────►
└──────────────────┘
        │ If not exists
        ▼
   Process event
        │
        ▼
   Store ID (TTL: 7 days)
```

**Implementation:**
```python
import hashlib
import redis

redis_client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379)

def process_idempotently(event):
    # Generate idempotency key
    event_id = event.get('id') or hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True).encode()
    ).hexdigest()
    
    # Check if already processed
    if redis_client.exists(f"processed:{event_id}"):
        print(f"Event {event_id} already processed, skipping")
        return
    
    # Process event
    try:
        result = process_event(event)
        
        # Mark as processed (TTL 7 days)
        redis_client.setex(
            f"processed:{event_id}",
            time=604800,
            value=json.dumps(result)
        )
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Processing failed: {e}")
        raise
```

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Pattern 2: Natural Idempotency        │
└────────────────────────────────────────┘

UPDATE users SET email = 'new@email.com' WHERE id = 123
  ↓
Multiple executions → Same result
```

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Pattern 3: Versioning/Optimistic Lock │
└────────────────────────────────────────┘

Event: {entity_id: 123, version: 5, data: {...}}
        │
        ▼
UPDATE entities 
   SET data = ?, version = 6 
 WHERE id = 123 AND version = 5
        │
        ▼ (0 rows affected if already applied)
   Idempotent
```

## 4. Backpressure Management

### **Architecture**

```
Fast Producer          Slow Consumer
     │                      │
     ▼                      ▼
┌─────────┐  100 msg/s  ┌──────────┐  10 msg/s  ┌──────────┐
│Producer │────────────►│  Queue   │───────────►│ Consumer │
└─────────┘             └──────────┘            └──────────┘
                             │
                             ▼ Queue grows
                        ┌──────────┐
                        │ OVERFLOW │
                        └──────────┘

Backpressure mechanisms:
1. Rate limiting
2. Flow control
3. Dynamic batching
4. Circuit breakers
```

### **Strategy 1: Consumer-Side Backpressure**

```python
from kafka import KafkaConsumer
import time

class BackpressureConsumer:
    def __init__(self, max_processing_time_ms=1000):
        self.consumer = KafkaConsumer(
            'orders',
            bootstrap_servers='localhost:9092',
            max_poll_records=100,  # Adjust batch size
            fetch_min_bytes=1024,  # Wait for more data
            fetch_max_wait_ms=500
        )
        self.max_processing_time = max_processing_time_ms
        self.current_batch_size = 100
    
    def consume(self):
        while True:
            start = time.time()
            messages = self.consumer.poll(timeout_ms=1000)
            
            for topic_partition, records in messages.items():
                for record in records:
                    process_message(record)
            
            processing_time = (time.time() - start) * 1000
            
            # Dynamic batch size adjustment
            if processing_time > self.max_processing_time:
                self.current_batch_size = max(10, self.current_batch_size // 2)
                self.consumer.pause(self.consumer.assignment())
                time.sleep(1)  # Backoff
                self.consumer.resume(self.consumer.assignment())
            else:
                self.current_batch_size = min(1000, self.current_batch_size * 1.1)
```

### **Strategy 2: Producer-Side Rate Limiting**

```python
from ratelimit import limits, sleep_and_retry

class RateLimitedProducer:
    def __init__(self, kafka_producer):
        self.producer = kafka_producer
        self.backpressure_detected = False
    
    @sleep_and_retry
    @limits(calls=100, period=1)  # 100 events per second
    def send_with_backpressure(self, topic, event):
        try:
            future = self.producer.send(topic, event)
            record_metadata = future.get(timeout=10)
            self.backpressure_detected = False
            return record_metadata
        except BufferError:
            # Producer buffer full
            self.backpressure_detected = True
            print("Backpressure detected, waiting...")
            time.sleep(1)
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Send failed: {e}")
            raise
```

### **Strategy 3: Circuit Breaker**

```python
from pybreaker import CircuitBreaker

class ConsumerWithCircuitBreaker:
    def __init__(self):
        self.circuit_breaker = CircuitBreaker(
            fail_max=5,           # Open after 5 failures
            timeout_duration=60   # Try again after 60s
        )
    
    @circuit_breaker
    def process_event(self, event):
        # External API call or heavy processing
        result = external_service.process(event)
        return result
    
    def consume(self):
        for message in self.consumer:
            try:
                self.process_event(message.value)
            except CircuitBreakerError:
                # Circuit open, save to DLQ
                self.send_to_dlq(message)
                print("Circuit breaker open, message sent to DLQ")
```

```python
        trace_id=trace_id,
        span_id=span_id,
        is_remote=True

        "consume_event",
        context=trace.set_span_in_context(trace.NonRecordingSpan(ctx))
```

from kafka import KafkaConsumer, TopicPartition
from kafka.structs import OffsetAndMetadata
import datetime

class ReplayableConsumer:
    def __init__(self, topics, group_id):
        self.consumer = KafkaConsumer(
            *topics,
            bootstrap_servers='localhost:9092',
            group_id=group_id,
            enable_auto_commit=False,
            auto_offset_reset='earliest'
        )
    
    def replay_from_timestamp(self, timestamp_ms):
        """Replay events from specific timestamp"""
        partitions = []
        for topic in self.consumer.subscription():
            topic_partitions = self.consumer.partitions_for_topic(topic)
            partitions.extend([
                TopicPartition(topic, p) for p in topic_partitions
            ])
        
        # Get offsets for timestamp
        offsets = self.consumer.offsets_for_times({
            tp: timestamp_ms for tp in partitions
        })
        
        # Seek to offset
        for tp, offset_and_timestamp in offsets.items():
            if offset_and_timestamp:
                self.consumer.seek(tp, offset_and_timestamp.offset)
        
        print(f"Replay started from {datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp_ms/1000)}")
    
    def replay_from_beginning(self):
        """Replay all events from start"""
        self.consumer.seek_to_beginning()
    
    def replay_specific_range(self, start_offset, end_offset):
        """Replay specific offset range"""
        for partition in self.consumer.assignment():
            self.consumer.seek(partition, start_offset)
        
        count = 0
        for message in self.consumer:
            if message.offset >= end_offset:
                break
            
            # Process message
            self.process_message(message)
            count += 1
        
        return count

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional
import uuid


class EventStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    PROCESSED = "processed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    DEAD_LETTER = "dead_letter"


class EventType(Enum):
    ORDER_CREATED = "order.created"
    ORDER_UPDATED = "order.updated"
    PAYMENT_PROCESSED = "payment.processed"
    INVENTORY_RESERVED = "inventory.reserved"


@dataclass
class Event:
    """Domain event with metadata for exactly-once processing"""
    event_id: str
    event_type: EventType
    aggregate_id: str
    payload: Dict[str, Any]
    idempotency_key: str
    created_at: datetime
    version: int = 1
    correlation_id: Optional[str] = None
    causation_id: Optional[str] = None
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @staticmethod
    def create(
        event_type: EventType,
        aggregate_id: str,
        payload: Dict[str, Any],
        correlation_id: Optional[str] = None,
        causation_id: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> 'Event':
        event_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        return Event(
            event_id=event_id,
            event_type=event_type,
            aggregate_id=aggregate_id,
            payload=payload,
            idempotency_key=f"{event_type.value}:{aggregate_id}:{event_id}",
            created_at=datetime.utcnow(),
            correlation_id=correlation_id or event_id,
            causation_id=causation_id
        )


@dataclass
class OutboxRecord:
    """Outbox pattern record"""
    id: str
    event: Event
    status: EventStatus
    created_at: datetime
    processed_at: Optional[datetime] = None
    retry_count: int = 0
    last_error: Optional[str] = None
    next_retry_at: Optional[datetime] = None

class ProcessingResult:

    event_id: str
    error: Optional[str] = None
```

```python
# database.py
import sqlite3
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import List, Optional
from contextlib import contextmanager
import threading


class DatabaseConnection:
    """Thread-safe database connection management"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_path: str = ":memory:"):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.local = threading.local()
    
    def get_connection(self):
        if not hasattr(self.local, 'conn'):
            self.local.conn = sqlite3.connect(
                self.db_path,
                check_same_thread=False,
                isolation_level=None  # Autocommit mode
            )
            self.local.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return self.local.conn
    
    @contextmanager
    def transaction(self):
        """Context manager for transactions"""
        conn = self.get_connection()
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            yield conn
            conn.execute("COMMIT")
        except Exception as e:
            conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise


class OutboxRepository:
    """Repository for outbox pattern with exactly-once guarantees"""
    
    def __init__(self, db: DatabaseConnection):
        self.db = db
        self._init_schema()
    
    def _init_schema(self):
        conn = self.db.get_connection()
        
        # Outbox table
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                event_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                aggregate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                correlation_id TEXT,
                causation_id TEXT,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                processed_at TEXT,
                retry_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                last_error TEXT,
                next_retry_at TEXT,
                metadata TEXT
            )
        """)
        
        # Processed events table (for deduplication)
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS processed_events (
                idempotency_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                processed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                result TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )
        """)
        
        # Indexes
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbox_status 
            ON outbox(status, next_retry_at)
        """)
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbox_created 
            ON outbox(created_at)
        """)
    
    def save_event_transactional(
        self,
        event: Event,
        business_operation: callable = None
    ) -> OutboxRecord:
        """
        Save event to outbox in same transaction as business operation.
        This ensures atomicity between business logic and event publishing.
        """
        with self.db.transaction() as conn:
            # Execute business operation first
            if business_operation:
                business_operation(conn)
            
            # Check for duplicate
            cursor = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM outbox WHERE idempotency_key = ?",
                (event.idempotency_key,)
            )
            if cursor.fetchone():
                raise DuplicateEventError(
                    f"Event with idempotency key {event.idempotency_key} already exists"
                )
            
            # Insert into outbox
            record_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT INTO outbox (
                    id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload,
                    idempotency_key, correlation_id, causation_id,
                    status, created_at, metadata
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, (
                record_id,
                event.event_id,
                event.event_type.value,
                event.aggregate_id,
                json.dumps(event.payload),
                event.idempotency_key,
                event.correlation_id,
                event.causation_id,
                EventStatus.PENDING.value,
                event.created_at.isoformat(),
                json.dumps(event.metadata)
            ))
            
            return self._get_by_id(conn, record_id)
    
    def get_pending_events(self, limit: int = 100) -> List[OutboxRecord]:
        """Get events ready for processing"""
        conn = self.db.get_connection()
        cursor = conn.execute("""
            SELECT * FROM outbox
            WHERE status = ?
               OR (status = ? AND next_retry_at <= ?)
            ORDER BY created_at
            LIMIT ?
        """, (
            EventStatus.PENDING.value,
            EventStatus.FAILED.value,
            datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
            limit
        ))
        
        return [self._row_to_record(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    
    def mark_processing(self, record_id: str) -> bool:
        """Mark event as being processed (with optimistic locking)"""
        conn = self.db.get_connection()
        cursor = conn.execute("""
            UPDATE outbox
            SET status = ?
            WHERE id = ? AND status IN (?, ?)
        """, (
            EventStatus.PROCESSING.value,
            record_id,
            EventStatus.PENDING.value,
            EventStatus.FAILED.value
        ))
        return cursor.rowcount > 0
    
    def mark_processed(self, record_id: str, result: ProcessingResult):
        """Mark event as successfully processed"""
        with self.db.transaction() as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                UPDATE outbox
                SET status = ?,
                    processed_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            """, (
                EventStatus.PROCESSED.value,
                datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                record_id
            ))
            
            # Record in processed events for deduplication
            record = self._get_by_id(conn, record_id)
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR IGNORE INTO processed_events (
                    idempotency_key, event_id, processed_at, result, created_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, (
                record.event.idempotency_key,
                record.event.event_id,
                datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                json.dumps(result.metadata),
                record.created_at.isoformat()
            ))
    
    def mark_failed(
        self,
        record_id: str,
        error: str,
        should_retry: bool = True,
        max_retries: int = 5
    ):
        """Mark event as failed with retry logic"""
        conn = self.db.get_connection()
        
        # Get current state
        record = self._get_by_id(conn, record_id)
        retry_count = record.retry_count + 1
        
        # Exponential backoff: 2^retry_count minutes
        next_retry = None
        new_status = EventStatus.FAILED.value
        
        if should_retry and retry_count < max_retries:
            backoff_minutes = 2 ** retry_count
            next_retry = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=backoff_minutes)
        elif retry_count >= max_retries:
            new_status = EventStatus.DEAD_LETTER.value
        
        conn.execute("""
            UPDATE outbox
            SET status = ?,
                retry_count = ?,
                last_error = ?,
                next_retry_at = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        """, (
            new_status,
            retry_count,
            error,
            next_retry.isoformat() if next_retry else None,
            record_id
        ))
    
    def is_already_processed(self, idempotency_key: str) -> bool:
        """Check if event was already processed (deduplication)"""
        conn = self.db.get_connection()
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM processed_events WHERE idempotency_key = ?",
            (idempotency_key,)
        )
        return cursor.fetchone() is not None
    
    def get_dead_letter_events(self) -> List[OutboxRecord]:
        """Get events that exceeded retry limit"""
        conn = self.db.get_connection()
        cursor = conn.execute("""
            SELECT * FROM outbox
            WHERE status = ?
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
        """, (EventStatus.DEAD_LETTER.value,))
        
        return [self._row_to_record(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    
    def _get_by_id(self, conn, record_id: str) -> OutboxRecord:
        cursor = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM outbox WHERE id = ?", (record_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            raise ValueError(f"Record {record_id} not found")
        return self._row_to_record(row)
    
    def _row_to_record(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> OutboxRecord:
        event = Event(
            event_id=row['event_id'],
            event_type=EventType(row['event_type']),
            aggregate_id=row['aggregate_id'],
            payload=json.loads(row['payload']),
            idempotency_key=row['idempotency_key'],
            created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row['created_at']),
            correlation_id=row['correlation_id'],
            causation_id=row['causation_id'],
            metadata=json.loads(row['metadata']) if row['metadata'] else {}
        )
        
        return OutboxRecord(
            id=row['id'],
            event=event,
            status=EventStatus(row['status']),
            created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row['created_at']),
            processed_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row['processed_at']) if row['processed_at'] else None,
            retry_count=row['retry_count'],
            last_error=row['last_error'],
            next_retry_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row['next_retry_at']) if row['next_retry_at'] else None
        )


class DuplicateEventError(Exception):
    """Raised when duplicate event is detected"""
    pass
```

```python
import queue
import threading
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Callable, List
import time


class MessageBroker(ABC):
    """Abstract message broker interface"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def publish(self, event: Event):
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def subscribe(self, event_type: EventType, handler: Callable[[Event], ProcessingResult]):
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def start(self):
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def stop(self):
        pass


class InMemoryBroker(MessageBroker):
    """In-memory message broker for demonstration (replace with real broker)"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.queues: Dict[EventType, queue.Queue] = {}
        self.handlers: Dict[EventType, List[Callable]] = {}
        self.workers: List[threading.Thread] = []
        self.running = False
    
    def publish(self, event: Event):
        if event.event_type not in self.queues:
            self.queues[event.event_type] = queue.Queue()
        self.queues[event.event_type].put(event)
    
    def subscribe(self, event_type: EventType, handler: Callable[[Event], ProcessingResult]):
        if event_type not in self.handlers:
            self.handlers[event_type] = []
        self.handlers[event_type].append(handler)
        
        if event_type not in self.queues:
            self.queues[event_type] = queue.Queue()
    
    def start(self):
        self.running = True
        for event_type in self.handlers:
            worker = threading.Thread(
                target=self._process_queue,
                args=(event_type,),
                daemon=True
            )
            worker.start()
            self.workers.append(worker)
    
    def stop(self):
        self.running = False
        for worker in self.workers:
            worker.join(timeout=5)
    
    def _process_queue(self, event_type: EventType):
        q = self.queues[event_type]
        handlers = self.handlers[event_type]
        
        while self.running:
            try:
                event = q.get(timeout=1)
                for handler in handlers:
                    try:
                        handler(event)
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"Handler error: {e}")
                q.task_done()
            except queue.Empty:
                continue
```

```python
# outbox_processor.py
import threading
import time
from typing import Optional
import logging


class OutboxProcessor:
    """
    Processes outbox events and publishes to message broker.
    Ensures exactly-once delivery.
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        repository: OutboxRepository,
        broker: MessageBroker,
        poll_interval: int = 5,
        batch_size: int = 100
    ):
        self.repository = repository
        self.broker = broker
        self.poll_interval = poll_interval
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.running = False
        self.thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    def start(self):
        """Start the outbox processor"""
        if self.running:
            return
        
        self.running = True
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._process_loop, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.logger.info("Outbox processor started")
    
    def stop(self):
        """Stop the outbox processor"""
        self.running = False
        if self.thread:
            self.thread.join(timeout=10)
        self.logger.info("Outbox processor stopped")
    
    def _process_loop(self):
        """Main processing loop"""
        while self.running:
            try:
                processed = self._process_batch()
                if processed == 0:
                    time.sleep(self.poll_interval)
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"Error in outbox processor: {e}", exc_info=True)
                time.sleep(self.poll_interval)
    
    def _process_batch(self) -> int:
        """Process a batch of pending events"""
        records = self.repository.get_pending_events(self.batch_size)
        
        for record in records:
            try:
                # Optimistic locking - only one processor will succeed
                if not self.repository.mark_processing(record.id):
                    continue
                
                # Publish to broker
                self.broker.publish(record.event)
                
                # Mark as processed
                result = ProcessingResult(
                    success=True,
                    event_id=record.event.event_id
                )
                self.repository.mark_processed(record.id, result)
                
                self.logger.info(
                    f"Published event {record.event.event_id}",
                    extra={
                        'event_id': record.event.event_id,
                        'event_type': record.event.event_type.value,
                        'correlation_id': record.event.correlation_id
                    }
                )
                
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(
                    f"Failed to process event {record.event.event_id}: {e}",
                    exc_info=True
                )
```

```python
# event_consumer.py
from typing import Callable, Dict
import logging


class IdempotentEventConsumer:
    """
    Event consumer with built-in idempotency and retry logic.
    Ensures exactly-once processing semantics.
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        repository: OutboxRepository,
        max_retries: int = 5
    ):
        self.repository = repository
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self.handlers: Dict[EventType, Callable] = {}
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    def register_handler(
        self,
        event_type: EventType,
        handler: Callable[[Event], ProcessingResult]
    ):
        """Register an event handler"""
        self.handlers[event_type] = handler
    
    def handle_event(self, event: Event) -> ProcessingResult:
        """
        Handle event with idempotency check and automatic retries.
        This is called by the message broker.
        """
        # Deduplication check
        if self.repository.is_already_processed(event.idempotency_key):
            self.logger.info(
                f"Event {event.event_id} already processed, skipping",
                extra={'idempotency_key': event.idempotency_key}
            )
            return ProcessingResult(
                success=True,
                event_id=event.event_id,
                metadata={'skipped': True, 'reason': 'already_processed'}
            )
        
        # Find handler
        handler = self.handlers.get(event.event_type)
        if not handler:
            error = f"No handler registered for {event.event_type}"
            self.logger.error(error)
            return ProcessingResult(
                success=False,
                event_id=event.event_id,
                error=error,
                should_retry=False
            )
        
        # Execute handler with retry logic
        retry_count = 0
        last_error = None
        
        while retry_count < self.max_retries:
            try:
                self.logger.info(
                    f"Processing event {event.event_id} (attempt {retry_count + 1})",
                    extra={
                        'event_id': event.event_id,
                        'event_type': event.event_type.value,
                        'correlation_id': event.correlation_id,
                        'attempt': retry_count + 1
                    }
                )
                
                result = handler(event)
                
                if result.success:
                    # Record successful processing for idempotency
                    self._record_processing(event, result)
                    return result
                
                last_error = result.error
                if not result.should_retry:
                    break
                
                retry_count += 1
                time.sleep(2 ** retry_count)  # Exponential backoff
                
            except Exception as e:
                last_error = str(e)
                self.logger.error(
                    f"Error processing event {event.event_id}: {e}",
                    exc_info=True
                )
                retry_count += 1
                time.sleep(2 ** retry_count)
        
        # All retries exhausted
        self.logger.error(
            f"Event {event.event_id} failed after {retry_count} attempts: {last_error}"
        )
        
        return ProcessingResult(
            success=False,
            event_id=event.event_id,
            error=last_error,
            should_retry=False
        )
    
    def _record_processing(self, event: Event, result: ProcessingResult):
        """Record successful processing for idempotency"""
```

import logging

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Optional, List
import json
from contextlib import contextmanager


@dataclass
class Span:
    """Distributed tracing span"""
    span_id: str
    trace_id: str
    parent_span_id: Optional[str]
    operation_name: str
    start_time: datetime
    end_time: Optional[datetime] = None
    tags: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    logs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def finish(self):
        self.end_time = datetime.utcnow()
    
    def duration_ms(self) -> Optional[float]:
        if self.end_time:
            delta = self.end_time - self.start_time
            return delta.total_seconds() * 1000
        return None


class Tracer:
    """Simple distributed tracer"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.spans: Dict[str, Span] = {}
        self.active_spans: Dict[str, Span] = {}
    
    @contextmanager
    def start_span(
        self,
        operation_name: str,
        trace_id: Optional[str] = None,
        parent_span_id: Optional[str] = None,
        tags: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    ):
        span_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        trace_id = trace_id or str(uuid.uuid4())
        
        span = Span(
            span_id=span_id,
            trace_id=trace_id,
            parent_span_id=parent_span_id,
            operation_name=operation_name,
            start_time=datetime.utcnow(),
            tags=tags or {}
        )
        
        self.spans[span_id] = span
        self.active_spans[trace_id] = span
        
        try:
            yield span
        finally:
            span.finish()
            if trace_id in self.active_spans:
                del self.active_spans[trace_id]
    
    def get_trace(self, trace_id: str) -> List[Span]:
        """Get all spans for a trace"""
        return [s for s in self.spans.values() if s.trace_id == trace_id]


@dataclass
class Metric:
    """System metric"""
    name: str
    value: float
    timestamp: datetime
    tags: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)


class MetricsCollector:
    """Collects and aggregates metrics"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.metrics: List[Metric] = []
        self.counters: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self.gauges: Dict[str, float] = {}
        self.histograms: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}
    
    def increment(self, name: str, tags: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None):
        """Increment a counter"""
        key = self._make_key(name, tags)
        self.counters[key] = self.counters.get(key, 0) + 1
    
    def gauge(self, name: str, value: float, tags: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None):
        """Set a gauge value"""
        key = self._make_key(name, tags)
        self.gauges[key] = value
    
    def histogram(self, name: str, value: float, tags: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None):
        """Record a histogram value"""
        key = self._make_key(name, tags)
        if key not in self.histograms:
            self.histograms[key] = []
        self.histograms[key].append(value)
    
    def get_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get aggregated statistics"""
        stats = {
            'counters': self.counters.copy(),
            'gauges': self.gauges.copy(),
            'histograms': {}
        }
        
        for key, values in self.histograms.items():
            if values:
                stats['histograms'][key] = {
                    'count': len(values),
                    'min': min(values),
                    'max': max(values),
                    'avg': sum(values) / len(values),
                    'p95': self._percentile(values, 95),
                    'p99': self._percentile(values, 99)
                }
        
        return stats
    
    def _make_key(self, name: str, tags: Optional[Dict[str, str]]) -> str:
        if tags:
            tag_str = ','.join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(tags.items()))
            return f"{name}[{tag_str}]"
        return name
    
    def _percentile(self, values: List[float], p: int) -> float:
        sorted_values = sorted(values)
        index = int(len(sorted_values) * p / 100)
        return sorted_values[min(index, len(sorted_values) - 1)]

```python
            'tables': tables,

            'has_aggregation': any(agg in sql.upper() for agg in ['SUM', 'AVG', 'COUNT']),

        }

        """Retrieve data contracts for tables"""
        contracts = {}
        for table in tables:
            contract = self.contract_registry.get_contract(table)
            if not contract:
                raise ValueError(f"No data contract found for table: {table}")
            contracts[table] = contract
        return contracts

        """Check if user has access to requested data"""
        for table, contract in contracts.items():
            access_config = contract.access
            
            # Check role-based access
            user_roles = set(context.roles)
            allowed_roles = {role['role'] for role in access_config.get('roles', [])}
            
            if not user_roles.intersection(allowed_roles):
                return {
                    'allowed': False,
                    'reason': f"User roles {user_roles} not authorized for {table}"
                }
            
            # Check purpose limitation
            if 'processing_purpose' in contract.privacy:
                if context.purpose not in contract.privacy['processing_purpose']:
                    return {
                        'allowed': False,
                        'reason': f"Purpose '{context.purpose}' not allowed for {table}"

                        f"{table}.{column}",
                        f"SHA256({table}.{column}||'{context.session_id}')"
                    )
                
                elif policy.technique == PrivacyTechnique.MASKING:
                    # Apply masking function
                    mask_type = policy.parameters.get('mask_type', 'partial')
                    if mask_type == 'partial':
                        transformed = transformed.replace(
                            f"{table}.{column}",
                            f"CONCAT(LEFT({table}.{column}, 3), '***')"
                        )
                    elif mask_type == 'full':
                        transformed = transformed.replace(
                            f"{table}.{column}",

                    # Enforce aggregation-only access
                    if not metadata['has_aggregation']:
```
