```typescript
// types/flags.ts
export enum FlagType {
  BOOLEAN = 'boolean',
  MULTIVARIATE = 'multivariate',
  OPERATIONAL = 'operational',
  PERMISSION = 'permission',
  KILL_SWITCH = 'kill_switch',
  EXPERIMENT = 'experiment'
}

export enum RolloutStrategy {
  ALL_USERS = 'all_users',
  PERCENTAGE = 'percentage',
  USER_LIST = 'user_list',
  GRADUAL = 'gradual',
  RING_BASED = 'ring_based',
  TARGETED = 'targeted',
  CANARY = 'canary'
}

export interface Flag {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  type: FlagType;
  defaultValue: any;
  enabled: boolean;
  
  // Metadata
  createdAt: Date;
  createdBy: string;
  modifiedAt: Date;
  modifiedBy: string;
  expiresAt?: Date;
  tags: string[];
  
  // Rollout configuration
  rollout: RolloutConfig;
  
  // Dependencies
  dependencies?: FlagDependency[];
  
  // Safety
  safetyChecks: SafetyCheck[];
  killSwitch?: KillSwitchConfig;
  
  // Observability
  metrics: MetricsConfig;
}

export interface RolloutConfig {
  strategy: RolloutStrategy;
  percentage?: number;
  gradualRollout?: GradualRolloutConfig;
  targeting?: TargetingRule[];
  rings?: Ring[];
  schedules?: RolloutSchedule[];
}

export interface GradualRolloutConfig {
  stages: RolloutStage[];
  autoProgress: boolean;
  progressionCriteria?: ProgressionCriteria;
}

export interface RolloutStage {
  name: string;
  percentage: number;
  durationMinutes: number;
  requiredHealthScore?: number;
  gates?: HealthGate[];
}

export interface TargetingRule {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  conditions: Condition[];
  operator: 'AND' | 'OR';
  value: any;
  enabled: boolean;
}

export interface Condition {
  attribute: string;
  operator: 'EQUALS' | 'NOT_EQUALS' | 'IN' | 'NOT_IN' | 
            'GREATER_THAN' | 'LESS_THAN' | 'REGEX' | 'SEMVER';
  value: any;
}

export interface Ring {
  name: string;
  percentage: number;
  prerequisites?: string[];
  waitDurationMinutes?: number;
}

export interface SafetyCheck {
  type: 'metric_threshold' | 'error_rate' | 'latency' | 'custom';
  metric: string;
  threshold: number;
  operator: 'LT' | 'GT' | 'EQ';
  window: string;
}

export interface KillSwitchConfig {
  enabled: boolean;
  triggers: KillSwitchTrigger[];
  autoRollback: boolean;
  notificationChannels: string[];
}

export interface KillSwitchTrigger {
  condition: SafetyCheck;
  action: 'disable' | 'rollback' | 'notify';
}

export interface MetricsConfig {
  trackExposure: boolean;
  trackEvaluation: boolean;
  customEvents: string[];
}
```

```typescript
// services/FeatureFlagService.ts
import { createHash } from 'crypto';
import * as Murmur from 'murmur-hash-js';

export class FeatureFlagService {
  private flags: Map<string, Flag> = new Map();
  private cache: FlagCache;
  private evaluator: FlagEvaluator;
  private metrics: MetricsCollector;
  private logger: Logger;
  
  constructor(
    private config: FeatureFlagConfig,
    private storage: FlagStorage,
    private eventBus: EventBus
  ) {
    this.cache = new FlagCache(config.cacheConfig);
    this.evaluator = new FlagEvaluator();
    this.metrics = new MetricsCollector();
    this.logger = new Logger('FeatureFlagService');
  }

  async initialize(): Promise<void> {
    // Load all flags from storage
    const flags = await this.storage.loadFlags();
    flags.forEach(flag => this.flags.set(flag.key, flag));
    
    // Start background sync
    this.startBackgroundSync();
    
    // Start health monitoring
    this.startHealthMonitoring();
    
    this.logger.info(`Initialized with ${flags.length} flags`);
  }

  async evaluate(
    flagKey: string,
    context: EvaluationContext,
    defaultValue?: any
  ): Promise<FlagEvaluation> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      // Check cache first
      const cacheKey = this.getCacheKey(flagKey, context);
      const cached = await this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) {
        this.recordEvaluation(flagKey, context, cached, true);
        return cached;
      }

      const flag = this.flags.get(flagKey);
      if (!flag) {
        return this.handleMissingFlag(flagKey, defaultValue);
      }

      // Check if flag is enabled
      if (!flag.enabled) {
        return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'disabled');
      }

      // Check dependencies
      if (flag.dependencies) {
        const depsResult = await this.checkDependencies(flag.dependencies, context);
        if (!depsResult.satisfied) {
          return this.createEvaluation(
            flag, 
            flag.defaultValue, 
            'dependency_failed',
            depsResult
          );
        }
      }

      // Evaluate targeting rules
      const evaluation = await this.evaluator.evaluate(flag, context);
      
      // Cache result
      await this.cache.set(cacheKey, evaluation, flag.rollout.cacheTTL);
      
      // Record metrics
      this.recordEvaluation(flagKey, context, evaluation, false);
      
      // Track exposure for experiments
      if (flag.type === FlagType.EXPERIMENT) {
        await this.trackExposure(flag, context, evaluation);
      }

      return evaluation;
      
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Flag evaluation error', { flagKey, error });
      this.metrics.increment('flag.evaluation.error', { flag: flagKey });
      return this.createEvaluation(
        { key: flagKey } as Flag,
        defaultValue,
        'error',
        { error: error.message }
      );
    } finally {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.metrics.timing('flag.evaluation.duration', duration, { flag: flagKey });
    }
  }

  async bulkEvaluate(
    flagKeys: string[],
    context: EvaluationContext
  ): Promise<Map<string, FlagEvaluation>> {
    const evaluations = new Map<string, FlagEvaluation>();
    
    // Evaluate in parallel
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      flagKeys.map(key => this.evaluate(key, context))
    );
    
    results.forEach((result, index) => {
      const flagKey = flagKeys[index];
      if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {
        evaluations.set(flagKey, result.value);
      } else {
        evaluations.set(flagKey, this.createEvaluation(
          { key: flagKey } as Flag,
          null,
          'error'
        ));
      }
    });
    
    return evaluations;
  }

  private getCacheKey(flagKey: string, context: EvaluationContext): string {
    const contextStr = JSON.stringify(context);
    const hash = createHash('md5').update(contextStr).digest('hex');
    return `flag:${flagKey}:${hash}`;
  }

  private recordEvaluation(
    flagKey: string,
    context: EvaluationContext,
    evaluation: FlagEvaluation,
    fromCache: boolean
  ): void {
    this.metrics.increment('flag.evaluation', {
      flag: flagKey,
      variant: evaluation.variant,
      reason: evaluation.reason,
      cached: fromCache.toString()
    });
    
    this.eventBus.publish('flag.evaluated', {
      flag: flagKey,
      context,
      evaluation,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    });
  }

  private async trackExposure(
    flag: Flag,
    context: EvaluationContext,
    evaluation: FlagEvaluation
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.metrics.track('flag.exposure', {
      flag: flag.key,
      userId: context.user?.id,
      variant: evaluation.variant,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    });
  }

  private createEvaluation(
    flag: Flag,
    value: any,
    reason: string,
    metadata?: any
  ): FlagEvaluation {
    return {
      flagKey: flag.key,
      value,
      variant: this.getVariantName(value),
      reason,
      metadata,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }
}
```

## 3. Flag Evaluator with Targeting Rules

```typescript
// services/FlagEvaluator.ts
export class FlagEvaluator {
  async evaluate(flag: Flag, context: EvaluationContext): Promise<FlagEvaluation> {
    // Apply rollout strategy
    switch (flag.rollout.strategy) {
      case RolloutStrategy.ALL_USERS:
        return this.evaluateAllUsers(flag);
        
      case RolloutStrategy.PERCENTAGE:
        return this.evaluatePercentage(flag, context);
        
      case RolloutStrategy.TARGETED:
        return this.evaluateTargeting(flag, context);
        
      case RolloutStrategy.GRADUAL:
        return this.evaluateGradual(flag, context);
        
      case RolloutStrategy.RING_BASED:
        return this.evaluateRings(flag, context);
        
      case RolloutStrategy.CANARY:
        return this.evaluateCanary(flag, context);
        
      default:
        return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'default');
    }
  }

  private evaluateAllUsers(flag: Flag): FlagEvaluation {
    return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.value, 'all_users');
  }

  private evaluatePercentage(
    flag: Flag,
    context: EvaluationContext
  ): FlagEvaluation {
    const percentage = flag.rollout.percentage || 0;
    const bucket = this.getUserBucket(context.user.id, flag.key);
    
    if (bucket < percentage) {
      return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.value, 'percentage_match', {
        bucket,
        percentage
      });
    }
    
    return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'percentage_miss', {
      bucket,
      percentage
    });
  }

  private async evaluateTargeting(
    flag: Flag,
    context: EvaluationContext
  ): Promise<FlagEvaluation> {
    const rules = flag.rollout.targeting || [];
    
    for (const rule of rules) {
      if (!rule.enabled) continue;
      
      const matches = await this.evaluateRule(rule, context);
      if (matches) {
        return this.createEvaluation(flag, rule.value, 'targeting_match', {
          ruleId: rule.id,
          ruleName: rule.description
        });
      }
    }
    
    return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'targeting_miss');
  }

  private async evaluateRule(
    rule: TargetingRule,
    context: EvaluationContext
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const results = await Promise.all(
      rule.conditions.map(condition => this.evaluateCondition(condition, context))
    );
    
    if (rule.operator === 'AND') {
      return results.every(r => r);
    } else {
      return results.some(r => r);
    }
  }

  private async evaluateCondition(
    condition: Condition,
    context: EvaluationContext
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const attributeValue = this.getAttributeValue(condition.attribute, context);
    
    switch (condition.operator) {
      case 'EQUALS':
        return attributeValue === condition.value;
        
      case 'NOT_EQUALS':
        return attributeValue !== condition.value;
        
      case 'IN':
        return Array.isArray(condition.value) && 
               condition.value.includes(attributeValue);
        
      case 'NOT_IN':
        return Array.isArray(condition.value) && 
               !condition.value.includes(attributeValue);
        
      case 'GREATER_THAN':
        return Number(attributeValue) > Number(condition.value);
        
      case 'LESS_THAN':
        return Number(attributeValue) < Number(condition.value);
        
      case 'REGEX':
        return new RegExp(condition.value).test(String(attributeValue));
        
      case 'SEMVER':
        return this.evaluateSemver(
          String(attributeValue),
          condition.value
        );
        
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  private evaluateGradual(
    flag: Flag,
    context: EvaluationContext
  ): FlagEvaluation {
    const gradualConfig = flag.rollout.gradualRollout!;
    const currentStage = this.getCurrentStage(gradualConfig);
    
    if (!currentStage) {
      return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'gradual_not_started');
    }
    
    const bucket = this.getUserBucket(context.user.id, flag.key);
    
    if (bucket < currentStage.percentage) {
      return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.value, 'gradual_match', {
        stage: currentStage.name,
        percentage: currentStage.percentage,
        bucket
      });
    }
    
    return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'gradual_miss', {
      stage: currentStage.name,
      percentage: currentStage.percentage,
      bucket
    });
  }

  private evaluateRings(
    flag: Flag,
    context: EvaluationContext
  ): FlagEvaluation {
    const rings = flag.rollout.rings || [];
    const userRing = context.user?.ring || context.organization?.ring;
    
    const ring = rings.find(r => r.name === userRing);
    if (!ring) {
      return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'ring_not_found', {
        userRing
      });
    }
    
    // Check prerequisites
    if (ring.prerequisites?.length) {
      // Prerequisites would be checked in dependency system
    }
    
    const bucket = this.getUserBucket(context.user.id, flag.key);
    
    if (bucket < ring.percentage) {
      return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.value, 'ring_match', {
        ring: ring.name,
        percentage: ring.percentage
      });
    }
    
    return this.createEvaluation(flag, flag.defaultValue, 'ring_miss', {
      ring: ring.name,
      percentage: ring.percentage
    });
  }

  private getUserBucket(userId: string, flagKey: string): number {
    // Use consistent hashing for stable bucketing
    const hash = Murmur.murmur3(`${userId}:${flagKey}`);
    return (hash % 10000) / 100; // Returns 0-100
  }

  private getAttributeValue(attribute: string, context: EvaluationContext): any {
    const parts = attribute.split('.');
    let value: any = context;
    
    for (const part of parts) {
      if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
        value = value[part];
      } else {
        return undefined;
      }
    }
    
    return value;
  }

  private getCurrentStage(config: GradualRolloutConfig): RolloutStage | null {
    // Logic to determine current stage based on schedule and progression
    // This would integrate with the rollout scheduler
    return config.stages[0]; // Simplified
  }

  private createEvaluation(
    flag: Flag,
    value: any,
    reason: string,
    metadata?: any
  ): FlagEvaluation {
    return {
      flagKey: flag.key,
      value,
      variant: this.getVariantName(value),
      reason,
      metadata,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }

  private getVariantName(value: any): string {
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
      return value ? 'on' : 'off';
    }
    return String(value);
  }

  private evaluateSemver(current: string, constraint: string): boolean {
```

```typescript
// services/ProgressiveRolloutManager.ts
export class ProgressiveRolloutManager {
  private schedulers: Map<string, RolloutScheduler> = new Map();
  
  constructor(
    private flagService: FeatureFlagService,
    private healthMonitor: HealthMonitor,
    private notifier: NotificationService
  ) {}

  async startGradualRollout(flagKey: string): Promise<void> {
    const flag = await this.flagService.getFlag(flagKey);
    if (!flag.rollout.gradualRollout) {
      throw new Error('Flag does not have gradual rollout configured');
    }
    
    const scheduler = new RolloutScheduler(
      flag,
      this.flagService,
      this.healthMonitor,
      this.notifier
    );
    
    this.schedulers.set(flagKey, scheduler);
    await scheduler.start();
  }

  async pauseRollout(flagKey: string): Promise<void> {
    const scheduler = this.schedulers.get(flagKey);
    if (scheduler) {
      await scheduler.pause();
    }
  }

  async resumeRollout(flagKey: string): Promise<void> {
    const scheduler = this.schedulers.get(flagKey);
    if (scheduler) {
      await scheduler.resume();
    }
  }

  async rollbackRollout(flagKey: string): Promise<void> {
    const scheduler = this.schedulers.get(flagKey);
    if (scheduler) {
      await scheduler.rollback();
    }
  }
}

export class RolloutScheduler {
  private currentStageIndex = 0;
  private stageStartTime?: Date;
  private status: 'running' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'failed' = 'running';
  private healthCheckInterval?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  
  constructor(
    private flag: Flag,
    private flagService: FeatureFlagService,
    private healthMonitor: HealthMonitor,
    private notifier: NotificationService
  ) {}

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    this.status = 'running';
    await this.progressToNextStage();
    this.startHealthMonitoring();
  }

  async pause(): Promise<void> {
    this.status = 'paused';
    this.stopHealthMonitoring();
    await this.notifier.send({
      channel: 'ops',
      message: `Rollout paused for flag: ${this.flag.key}`,
      severity: 'warning'
    });
  }

  async resume(): Promise<void> {
    this.status = 'running';
    this.startHealthMonitoring();
    await this.notifier.send({
      channel: 'ops',
      message: `Rollout resumed for flag: ${this.flag.key}`,
      severity: 'info'
    });
  }

  async rollback(): Promise<void> {
    this.status = 'failed';
    this.stopHealthMonitoring();
    
    // Set percentage back to 0 or previous safe state
    await this.flagService.updateFlag(this.flag.key, {
      rollout: {
        ...this.flag.rollout,
        percentage: 0
      }
    });
    
    await this.notifier.send({
      channel: 'ops',
      message: `Rollout rolled back for flag: ${this.flag.key}`,
      severity: 'critical'
    });
  }

  private async progressToNextStage(): Promise<void> {
    const stages = this.flag.rollout.gradualRollout!.stages;
    
    if (this.currentStageIndex >= stages.length) {
      this.status = 'completed';
      await this.notifier.send({
        channel: 'ops',
        message: `Rollout completed for flag: ${this.flag.key}`,
        severity: 'info'
      });
      return;
    }
    
    const stage = stages[this.currentStageIndex];
    this.stageStartTime = new Date();
    
    // Update flag percentage
    await this.flagService.updateFlag(this.flag.key, {
      rollout: {
        ...this.flag.rollout,
        percentage: stage.percentage
      }
    });
    
    await this.notifier.send({
      channel: 'ops',
      message: `Rollout stage ${stage.name} started for flag: ${this.flag.key} (${stage.percentage}%)`,
      severity: 'info'
    });
    
    // Schedule next stage
    if (this.flag.rollout.gradualRollout!.autoProgress) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (this.status === 'running') {
          this.checkStageHealth().then(healthy => {
            if (healthy) {
              this.currentStageIndex++;
              this.progressToNextStage();
            } else {
              this.rollback();
            }
          });
        }
      }, stage.durationMinutes * 60 * 1000);
    }
  }

  private startHealthMonitoring(): void {
    this.healthCheckInterval = setInterval(async () => {
      const healthy = await this.checkStageHealth();
      if (!healthy && this.flag.killSwitch?.autoRollback) {
        await this.rollback();
      }
    }, 60000); // Check every minute
  }

  private stopHealthMonitoring(): void {
    if (this.healthCheckInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.healthCheckInterval);
    }
  }

  private async checkStageHealth(): Promise<boolean> {
    const stage = this.flag.rollout.gradualRollout!.stages[this.currentStageIndex];
    
    if (!stage.gates?.length) {
      return true;
    }
    
    const results = await Promise.all(
      stage.gates.map(gate => this.healthMonitor.checkGate(gate, this.flag.key))
    );
    
    return results.every(r => r.healthy);
  }
}
```

```typescript
// services/KillSwitchManager.ts
export class KillSwitchManager {
  private monitors: Map<string, KillSwitchMonitor> = new Map();
  
  constructor(
    private flagService: FeatureFlagService,
    private metricsService: MetricsService,
    private notifier: NotificationService,
    private logger: Logger
  ) {}

  async registerKillSwitch(flag: Flag): Promise<void> {
    if (!flag.killSwitch?.enabled) {
      return;
    }
    
    const monitor = new KillSwitchMonitor(
      flag,
      this.flagService,
      this.metricsService,
      this.notifier,
      this.logger
    );
    
    this.monitors.set(flag.key, monitor);
    await monitor.start();
  }

  async triggerKillSwitch(
    flagKey: string,
    reason: string,
    triggeredBy: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    this.logger.warn('Kill switch triggered', { flagKey, reason, triggeredBy });
    
    await this.flagService.updateFlag(flagKey, {
      enabled: false
    });
    
    await this.notifier.send({
      channel: 'critical',
      message: `🚨 Kill switch activated for ${flagKey}: ${reason}`,
      severity: 'critical',
      metadata: { flagKey, reason, triggeredBy }
    });
    
    await this.metricsService.track('killswitch.triggered', {
      flag: flagKey,
      reason,
      triggeredBy,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    });
  }

  async disableKillSwitch(flagKey: string): Promise<void> {
    const monitor = this.monitors.get(flagKey);
    if (monitor) {
      await monitor.stop();
      this.monitors.delete(flagKey);
    }
  }
}

export class KillSwitchMonitor {
  private checkInterval?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  private isActive = false;
  
  constructor(
    private flag: Flag,
    private flagService: FeatureFlagService,
    private metricsService: MetricsService,
    private notifier: NotificationService,
    private logger: Logger
  ) {}

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    this.isActive = true;
    this.checkInterval = setInterval(() => this.check(), 30000); // Check every 30s
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    this.isActive = false;
    if (this.checkInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.checkInterval);
    }
  }

  private async check(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.isActive || !this.flag.killSwitch) {
      return;
    }
    
    for (const trigger of this.flag.killSwitch.triggers) {
      const shouldTrigger = await this.evaluateTrigger(trigger);
      
      if (shouldTrigger) {
        await this.executeTriggerAction(trigger);
      }
    }
  }

  private async evaluateTrigger(trigger: KillSwitchTrigger): Promise<boolean> {
    const { condition } = trigger;
    
    try {
      const metricValue = await this.metricsService.query(
        condition.metric,
        condition.window,
        { flag: this.flag.key }
      );
      
      switch (condition.operator) {
        case 'GT':
          return metricValue > condition.threshold;
        case 'LT':
          return metricValue < condition.threshold;
        case 'EQ':
          return metricValue === condition.threshold;
        default:
          return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Kill switch evaluation error', { 
        flag: this.flag.key,
        trigger,
        error 
      });
      return false;
    }
  }

  private async executeTriggerAction(trigger: KillSwitchTrigger): Promise<void> {
    switch (trigger.action) {
      case 'disable':
        await this.flagService.updateFlag(this.flag.key, { enabled: false });
        break;
        
      case 'rollback':
        await this.flagService.updateFlag(this.flag.key, {
          rollout: { ...this.flag.rollout, percentage: 0 }
        });
        break;
        
      case 'notify':
        await this.notifier.send({
          channel: 'ops',
          message: `Kill switch condition met for ${this.flag.key}`,
          severity: 'warning'
        });
        break;
    }
    
    this.logger.warn('Kill switch action executed', {
      flag: this.flag.key,
      action: trigger.action,
      condition: trigger.condition
    });
  }
}
```

// services/ConfigDriftDetector.ts
export class ConfigDriftDetector {
  constructor(
    private flagService: FeatureFlagService,
    private storage: FlagStorage,
    private notifier: NotificationService,
    private logger: Logger
  ) {}

  async detectDrift(): Promise<DriftReport> {
    const report: DriftReport = {
      timestamp: new Date(),
      drifts: [],
      summary: {
        totalFlags: 0,
        flagsWithDrift: 0,
        criticalDrifts: 0
      }
    };
    
    // Get all flags from all sources
    const localFlags = await this.flagService.getAllFlags();
    const remoteFlags = await this.storage.loadFlags();
    const runtimeFlags = this.flagService.getRuntimeFlags();
    
    report.summary.totalFlags = localFlags.length;
    
    // Compare local vs remote
    const localRemoteDrifts = this.compareFlags(
      localFlags,
      remoteFlags,
      'local',
      'remote'
    );
    
    // Compare runtime vs local
    const runtimeLocalDrifts = this.compareFlags(
      runtimeFlags,
      localFlags,
      'runtime',
      'local'
    );
    
    report.drifts.push(...localRemoteDrifts, ...runtimeLocalDrifts);
    report.summary.flagsWithDrift = new Set(
      report.drifts.map(d => d.flagKey)
    ).size;
    report.summary.criticalDrifts = report.drifts.filter(

```python
# Python tenant database manager
from dataclasses import dataclass

import psycopg2
from psycopg2 import sql

@dataclass
class TenantConfig:
    tenant_id: str
    db_name: str
    host: str
    port: int
    tier: str

class TenantDatabaseManager:
    def __init__(self, admin_conn_string: str):
        self.admin_conn = psycopg2.connect(admin_conn_string)
        self.admin_conn.autocommit = True
        self.tenant_registry: Dict[str, TenantConfig] = {}
    
    def provision_tenant_database(
        self, 
        tenant_id: str, 
        tier: str = 'basic'
    ) -> TenantConfig:
        """Provision a new database for a tenant"""
        db_name = f"tenant_{tenant_id.replace('-', '_')}"
        db_user = f"user_{db_name}"
        db_password = self._generate_secure_password()
        
        with self.admin_conn.cursor() as cursor:
            # Create database
            cursor.execute(
                sql.SQL("CREATE DATABASE {}").format(
                    sql.Identifier(db_name)
                )
            )
            
            # Create user with limited privileges
            cursor.execute(
                sql.SQL(
                    "CREATE USER {} WITH PASSWORD %s"
                ).format(sql.Identifier(db_user)),
                [db_password]
            )
            
            # Grant privileges
            cursor.execute(
                sql.SQL(
                    "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE {} TO {}"
                ).format(
                    sql.Identifier(db_name),
                    sql.Identifier(db_user)
                )
            )
        
        # Apply schema migrations
        self._apply_schema_template(db_name)
        
        # Configure resource limits based on tier
        self._configure_resource_limits(db_name, tier)
        
        config = TenantConfig(
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            db_name=db_name,
            host=self._get_host_for_tier(tier),
            port=5432,
            tier=tier
        )
        
        self.tenant_registry[tenant_id] = config
        return config
    
    def _configure_resource_limits(self, db_name: str, tier: str):
        """Set per-database resource limits"""
        limits = {
            'basic': {
                'max_connections': 20,
                'statement_timeout': '30s',
                'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout': '60s'
            },
            'premium': {
                'max_connections': 100,
                'statement_timeout': '120s',
                'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout': '300s'
            },
            'enterprise': {
                'max_connections': 500,
                'statement_timeout': '300s',
                'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout': '600s'
            }
        }
        
        config = limits.get(tier, limits['basic'])
        
        with self.admin_conn.cursor() as cursor:
            for key, value in config.items():
                cursor.execute(
                    sql.SQL(
                        "ALTER DATABASE {} SET {} = %s"
                    ).format(
```

```typescript
// TypeScript JWT-based auth with tenant context
interface TenantClaims {
  tenantId: string;
  userId: string;
  roles: string[];
  permissions: string[];

class TenantAuthService {
  // Authenticate and inject tenant context
  async authenticate(
    token: string
  ): Promise<TenantClaims> {
    const payload = await this.verifyToken(token);
    
    // Validate tenant is active
    const tenant = await this.validateTenant(payload.tenantId);
    if (tenant.status !== 'active') {
      throw new UnauthorizedError('Tenant is not active');
    }
    
    // Check if user belongs to tenant
    const user = await this.validateUserTenant(
      payload.userId, 
      payload.tenantId
    );
    
    // Load permissions based on user roles
    const permissions = await this.loadPermissions(
      payload.roles,
      payload.tenantId
    );
    
    return {
      tenantId: payload.tenantId,
      userId: payload.userId,
      roles: payload.roles,
      permissions,
      tier: tenant.tier
    };
  }
  
  // Authorization middleware
  requirePermission(permission: string) {
    return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const claims = req.tenantContext;
      
      if (!claims) {
        return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
      }
      
      // Check tenant-level feature flags
      if (!this.hasFeatureAccess(claims.tier, permission)) {
        return res.status(403).json({ 
          error: 'Feature not available in your plan' 
        });
      }
      
      // Check user permissions
      if (!claims.permissions.includes(permission)) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden' });
      }
      
      next();
    };
  }
  
  private hasFeatureAccess(tier: string, feature: string): boolean {
    const tierFeatures = {
      basic: ['read', 'write'],
      premium: ['read', 'write', 'export', 'analytics'],
      enterprise: ['read', 'write', 'export', 'analytics', 'api', 'webhooks']
    };
    
    return tierFeatures[tier]?.includes(feature) ?? false;
  }
}
```

```sql
-- Efficient permission check function

    p_user_id UUID,
    p_resource VARCHAR,
    p_action VARCHAR
) RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM user_roles ur
        JOIN role_permissions rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id
        JOIN permissions p ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id
        WHERE ur.user_id = p_user_id
          AND p.resource = p_resource
          AND p.action = p_action
    );
$$ LANGUAGE sql STABLE;
```

```python
# Python connection pool manager with tenant isolation
import asyncpg
from typing import Dict, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
import asyncio

@dataclass
class PoolLimits:
    max_connections: int
    max_queries_per_second: int
    max_concurrent_queries: int

class TenantAwareConnectionPool:
    def __init__(self, dsn: str):
        self.dsn = dsn
        self.main_pool: Optional[asyncpg.Pool] = None
        self.tenant_limits: Dict[str, PoolLimits] = {}
        self.tenant_metrics: Dict[str, dict] = {}
        self._rate_limiters: Dict[str, asyncio.Semaphore] = {}
    
    async def initialize(self, min_size: int = 10, max_size: int = 100):
        """Initialize main connection pool"""
        self.main_pool = await asyncpg.create_pool(
            self.dsn,
            min_size=min_size,
            max_size=max_size,
            command_timeout=60,
            server_settings={
                'application_name': 'saas_app'
            }
        )
    
    def configure_tenant_limits(
        self, 
        tenant_id: str, 
        limits: PoolLimits
    ):
        """Set resource limits per tenant"""
        self.tenant_limits[tenant_id] = limits
        self._rate_limiters[tenant_id] = asyncio.Semaphore(
            limits.max_concurrent_queries
        )
        self.tenant_metrics[tenant_id] = {
            'query_count': 0,
            'active_queries': 0,
            'throttled_count': 0,
            'last_reset': asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
        }
    
    async def acquire_connection(self, tenant_id: str):
        """Acquire connection with tenant-specific rate limiting"""
        # Check rate limits
        if not await self._check_rate_limit(tenant_id):
            raise RateLimitExceeded(
                f"Tenant {tenant_id} exceeded rate limit"
            )
        
        # Acquire connection with concurrency control
        limiter = self._rate_limiters.get(tenant_id)
        if limiter:
            await limiter.acquire()
        
        try:
            conn = await self.main_pool.acquire(timeout=5)
            
            # Set tenant context
            await conn.execute(
                'SELECT set_tenant_context($1)',
                tenant_id
            )
            
            # Set statement timeout based on tier
            limits = self.tenant_limits.get(tenant_id)
            if limits:
                timeout = self._get_timeout_for_limits(limits)
                await conn.execute(
                    f'SET statement_timeout = {timeout}'
                )
            
            self._update_metrics(tenant_id, 'acquire')
            
            return TenantConnection(
                conn, 
                tenant_id, 
                self._release_callback
            )
        except Exception as e:
            if limiter:
                limiter.release()
            raise
    
    async def _check_rate_limit(self, tenant_id: str) -> bool:
        """Check if tenant is within rate limits"""
        if tenant_id not in self.tenant_limits:
            return True
        
        metrics = self.tenant_metrics[tenant_id]
        limits = self.tenant_limits[tenant_id]
        current_time = asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
        
        # Reset counter if time window passed
        if current_time - metrics['last_reset'] >= 1.0:
            metrics['query_count'] = 0
            metrics['last_reset'] = current_time
        
        if metrics['query_count'] >= limits.max_queries_per_second:
            metrics['throttled_count'] += 1
            return False
        
        metrics['query_count'] += 1
        return True
    
    def _release_callback(self, tenant_id: str):
        """Callback when connection is released"""
        if tenant_id in self._rate_limiters:
            self._rate_limiters[tenant_id].release()
        self._update_metrics(tenant_id, 'release')

class TenantConnection:
    """Wrapper around database connection"""
    def __init__(self, conn, tenant_id: str, release_callback):
        self._conn = conn
        self.tenant_id = tenant_id
        self._release_callback = release_callback
    
    async def __aenter__(self):
        return self._conn
    
    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
        await self._conn.close()
        self._release_callback(self.tenant_id)
```

```python
# Query governor to prevent runaway queries
from typing import Optional
import time

class QueryGovernor:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tenant_quotas = {}
        self.active_queries = {}
    
    async def check_query(
        self, 
        tenant_id: str, 
        query: str,
        estimated_cost: Optional[float] = None
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Evaluate if query should be allowed to execute
        Returns True if allowed, False if blocked
        """
        # Check for expensive operations
        if self._is_dangerous_query(query):
            await self._log_blocked_query(
                tenant_id, 
                query, 
                'dangerous_operation'
            )
            return False
        
        # Check estimated cost
        if estimated_cost and estimated_cost > self._get_cost_limit(tenant_id):
            await self._log_blocked_query(
                tenant_id, 
                query, 
                'cost_exceeded'
            )
            return False
        
        # Check concurrent query limit
        active_count = self.active_queries.get(tenant_id, 0)
        if active_count >= self._get_concurrency_limit(tenant_id):
            await self._log_blocked_query(
                tenant_id, 
                query, 
                'concurrency_limit'
            )
            return False
        
        return True
    
    def _is_dangerous_query(self, query: str) -> bool:
        """Check for potentially dangerous query patterns"""
        query_lower = query.lower()
        
        dangerous_patterns = [
            'select * from',  # full table scans
            'cross join',     # cartesian products
            'without index',  # missing index hints
        ]
        
        return any(pattern in query_lower for pattern in dangerous_patterns)
    
    async def track_query_execution(
        self, 
        tenant_id: str, 
        query: str
    ):
        """Context manager to track query execution"""
        return QueryExecutionContext(self, tenant_id, query)

class QueryExecutionContext:
    def __init__(self, governor: QueryGovernor, tenant_id: str, query: str):
        self.governor = governor
        self.tenant_id = tenant_id
        self.query = query
        self.start_time = None
    
    async def __aenter__(self):
        self.start_time = time.time()
        self.governor.active_queries[self.tenant_id] = \
            self.governor.active_queries.get(self.tenant_id, 0) + 1
        return self
    
    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
        self.governor.active_queries[self.tenant_id] -= 1
        duration = time.time() - self.start_time
        
        # Log slow queries
        if duration > 5.0:
            await self.governor._log_slow_query(
                self.tenant_id,
                self.query,
                duration
            )
```

```typescript
  async getTenantCosts(

    endDate: Date
  ): Promise<CostSummary> {
    const result = await this.db.query(`
      SELECT 
        resource_type,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        SUM(cost_usd) as total_cost_usd,
        COUNT(*) as event_count
      FROM tenant_resource_usage
      WHERE tenant_id = $1
        AND recorded_at BETWEEN $2 AND $3
      GROUP BY resource_type

    return {
      tenantId,
      period: { start: startDate, end: endDate },
      breakdown: result.rows,
      totalCost: result.rows.reduce(
        (sum, row) => sum + parseFloat(row.total_cost_usd),
        0
      )
    };
  }
  
  private async checkCostThresholds(tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const tenant = await this.getTenant(tenantId);
    const currentMonthCost = await this.getCurrentMonthCost(tenantId);
    
    const threshold = tenant.settings?.cost_limit_usd || Infinity;
    const warningThreshold = threshold * 0.8;
    
    if (currentMonthCost >= threshold) {
      await this.handleCostLimitExceeded(tenantId, currentMonthCost);
    } else if (currentMonthCost >= warningThreshold) {
      await this.sendCostWarning(tenantId, currentMonthCost, threshold);
    }
  }

    const tenantId = req.tenantContext?.tenantId;
    
    if (!tenantId) {
      return next();
    }
    
    // Track API call
    await costService.trackApiCall(tenantId, req.path);
    
    // Track compute time after response
    res.on('finish', async () => {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      await costService.trackComputeTime(tenantId, req.path, duration);
    });
    
    next();
  };
}
```

```javascript
const express = require('express');
const { trace, context, SpanStatusCode, propagation } = require('@opentelemetry/api');
const axios = require('axios');

const app = express();

  if (span) {
    span.setAttribute('user.id', req.headers['x-user-id'] || 'anonymous');
    span.setAttribute('tenant.id', req.headers['x-tenant-id']);
  }
  next();
});

// Example endpoint with manual spans
app.get('/api/users/:id', async (req, res) => {
  const parentSpan = trace.getActiveSpan();
  
  // Create child span for database operation
  const dbSpan = tracer.startSpan('postgres.query', {
    attributes: {
      'db.system': 'postgresql',
      'db.operation': 'SELECT',
      'db.statement': 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1',
    },
  });
  
  try {
    // Simulate DB query
    const user = await context.with(
      trace.setSpan(context.active(), dbSpan),
      async () => {
        // Your DB query here
        return { id: req.params.id, name: 'John Doe' };
      }
    );
    
    dbSpan.setStatus({ code: SpanStatusCode.OK });
    dbSpan.end();
    
    // Call worker service with context propagation
    const processedData = await callWorkerService(user);
    
    res.json({ user, processed: processedData });
    
  } catch (error) {
    dbSpan.recordException(error);
    dbSpan.setStatus({
      code: SpanStatusCode.ERROR,
      message: error.message,
    });
    dbSpan.end();
    
    if (parentSpan) {
      parentSpan.recordException(error);
      parentSpan.setStatus({ code: SpanStatusCode.ERROR });
    }
    
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
  }
});

// Context propagation to downstream service
async function callWorkerService(data) {
  const span = tracer.startSpan('http.client.worker-service', {
    attributes: {
      'http.method': 'POST',
      'http.url': 'http://worker-service:3001/process',
      'peer.service': 'worker-service',
    },
  });
  
  return await context.with(
    trace.setSpan(context.active(), span),
    async () => {
      try {
        // Inject context into HTTP headers
        const headers = {};
        propagation.inject(context.active(), headers);
        
        const response = await axios.post(
          'http://worker-service:3001/process',
          data,
          { headers }
        );
        
        span.setStatus({ code: SpanStatusCode.OK });
        span.setAttribute('http.status_code', response.status);
        return response.data;
        
      } catch (error) {
        span.recordException(error);
        span.setStatus({ code: SpanStatusCode.ERROR });
        throw error;
      } finally {
        span.end();
      }
    }
  );
}

// Baggage example - propagate metadata across services

app.post('/api/orders', (req, res) => {

  // Set baggage (propagated to all downstream services)
  const bag = baggage.setEntry(
    baggage.setEntry(
      context.active(),
      'order.priority',
      { value: 'high' }
    ),
    'customer.tier',
    { value: 'premium' }
  );
  
  context.with(bag, async () => {
    // All spans in this context will have access to baggage
    await processOrder(req.body);
  });
  
  res.json({ status: 'processing' });
});
```

```python
    finally:
```

```python
# custom_sampling.py
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.sampling import (
    Sampler,
    SamplingResult,
    Decision,
    ParentBased,
)
from opentelemetry.trace import SpanKind

class CustomSampler(Sampler):
    """
    Custom sampling logic:
    - Always sample errors
    - Sample 100% of high-value transactions
    - Sample 10% of normal traffic
    """
    
    def should_sample(
        self,
        parent_context,
        trace_id,
        name,
        kind=None,
        attributes=None,
        links=None,
        trace_state=None,
    ):
        # Always sample if parent was sampled
        parent_span = trace.get_current_span(parent_context)
        if parent_span.get_span_context().trace_flags.sampled:
            return SamplingResult(Decision.RECORD_AND_SAMPLE)
        
        # Check for high-value indicators
        if attributes:
            if attributes.get("customer.tier") == "premium":
                return SamplingResult(
                    Decision.RECORD_AND_SAMPLE,
                    attributes={"sampling.priority": "high"}
                )
            
            if attributes.get("http.status_code", 0) >= 400:
                return SamplingResult(
                    Decision.RECORD_AND_SAMPLE,
                    attributes={"sampling.reason": "error"}
                )
        
        # Default: 10% sampling
        if trace_id % 10 == 0:
            return SamplingResult(Decision.RECORD_AND_SAMPLE)
        
        return SamplingResult(Decision.DROP)
    
    def get_description(self):
        return "CustomBusinessLogicSampler"

# Usage in tracing.py
provider = TracerProvider(
    resource=resource,
    sampler=ParentBased(root=CustomSampler()),
```

```yaml
      processors: [filter, resource, tail_sampling, batch, attributes]
```

# Blue-Green Database Migrations

## Overview

Blue-green database migrations enable **zero-downtime schema changes** by maintaining compatibility between old and new application versions during the transition.

## 1. Expand → Migrate → Contract Pattern

This three-phase approach safely evolves database schemas:

### **Phase 1: EXPAND** 
Add new structures without removing old ones

```sql
-- Example: Renaming 'email' to 'email_address'

-- EXPAND: Add new column
ALTER TABLE users 
ADD COLUMN email_address VARCHAR(255);

-- Both columns exist temporarily
-- Old app uses: email
-- New app can use: email_address
```

### **Phase 2: MIGRATE**
Copy/transform data from old to new structures

```sql
-- Backfill existing data
UPDATE users 
SET email_address = email 
WHERE email_address IS NULL;

-- Set up triggers for ongoing sync (dual-write at DB level)
CREATE TRIGGER sync_email_forward
AFTER UPDATE ON users
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF NEW.email != OLD.email THEN
    SET NEW.email_address = NEW.email;
  END IF;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER sync_email_backward
AFTER UPDATE ON users
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF NEW.email_address != OLD.email_address THEN
    SET NEW.email = NEW.email_address;
  END IF;
END;
```

### **Phase 3: CONTRACT**
Remove old structures after full cutover

```sql
-- Once all apps use new column
DROP TRIGGER sync_email_forward;
DROP TRIGGER sync_email_backward;

ALTER TABLE users 
DROP COLUMN email;
```

## 2. Dual-Write/Compare Strategy

Writes go to **both old and new** structures to maintain consistency:

### **Application-Level Dual Write**

```python
class UserRepository:
    def update_email(self, user_id, new_email):
        # Write to BOTH columns during migration
        query = """
            UPDATE users 
            SET email = %s,
                email_address = %s  -- dual write
            WHERE id = %s
        """
        db.execute(query, (new_email, new_email, user_id))
```

### **Read from Old, Write to Both**

```python
class UserService:
    def __init__(self):
        self.use_new_column = FeatureFlag.get('use_new_email_column')
    
    def get_email(self, user):
        # Gradually shift reads
        if self.use_new_column:
            return user.email_address or user.email  # fallback
        return user.email
    
    def set_email(self, user, email):
        # Always write both during migration
        user.email = email
        user.email_address = email
        user.save()
```

### **Data Validation/Comparison**

```python
def validate_migration():
    """Compare old vs new to verify data integrity"""
    discrepancies = db.query("""
        SELECT id, email, email_address
        FROM users
        WHERE email != email_address
           OR (email IS NULL) != (email_address IS NULL)
    """)
    
    if discrepancies:
        alert(f"Found {len(discrepancies)} mismatches")
        return False
    return True
```

## 3. Cutover Window

The critical moment when traffic switches from old to new:

### **Staged Cutover**

```python
# Phase 1: Canary (1% of traffic)
FeatureFlag.set('use_new_email_column', percentage=1)

# Phase 2: Gradual rollout
FeatureFlag.set('use_new_email_column', percentage=10)
FeatureFlag.set('use_new_email_column', percentage=50)

# Phase 3: Full cutover
FeatureFlag.set('use_new_email_column', percentage=100)
```

### **Cutover Checklist**

```yaml
Pre-Cutover:
  - [ ] Data fully migrated (verify row counts)
  - [ ] Dual-write enabled and tested
  - [ ] Data validation passing (0 discrepancies)
  - [ ] New code deployed to all instances
  - [ ] Performance testing completed
  - [ ] Monitoring dashboards ready
  
During Cutover:
  - [ ] Enable new schema reads (feature flag)
  - [ ] Monitor error rates
  - [ ] Monitor query performance
  - [ ] Verify data consistency
  
Post-Cutover:
  - [ ] Run for 24-48 hours before CONTRACT phase
  - [ ] Remove dual-write triggers
  - [ ] Drop old columns (CONTRACT phase)
```

## 4. Rollback Plan

Critical safety mechanism if issues arise:

### **Immediate Rollback (During Cutover)**

```python
# Simply flip feature flag back
FeatureFlag.set('use_new_email_column', percentage=0)

# Old column still has all data
# Application immediately reads from old schema
```

### **Database-Level Rollback**

```sql
-- If you need to revert the EXPAND phase
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email_address;

-- If you prematurely dropped old column (CONTRACT)
-- Must restore from backup (why you wait 24-48h!)
```

### **Rollback Strategy by Phase**

| Phase | Rollback Method | Risk Level |
|-------|----------------|------------|
| **EXPAND** | `DROP COLUMN` | ✅ Low - old data intact |
| **MIGRATE** | Stop backfill, fix bugs | ✅ Low - both exist |
| **Cutover** | Flip feature flag | ✅ Low - both exist |
| **CONTRACT** | Restore from backup | ⚠️ HIGH - data loss risk |

### **Automated Rollback Trigger**

```python
class MigrationMonitor:
    def __init__(self):
        self.error_threshold = 0.05  # 5% error rate
        self.baseline_latency = get_baseline_p99()
    
    def monitor_cutover(self):
        while True:
            metrics = get_current_metrics()
            
            # Auto-rollback conditions
            if metrics.error_rate > self.error_threshold:
                self.rollback("Error rate exceeded threshold")
            
            if metrics.p99_latency > self.baseline_latency * 2:
                self.rollback("Latency degradation detected")
            
            if metrics.data_consistency_check_failed:
                self.rollback("Data inconsistency detected")
            
            time.sleep(60)
    
    def rollback(self, reason):
        logger.critical(f"AUTO-ROLLBACK: {reason}")
        FeatureFlag.set('use_new_email_column', percentage=0)
        alert_team(reason)
```

## Complete Example: Splitting a Column

```python
# Step 1: EXPAND (Deploy V1)
"""
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN first_name VARCHAR(100);
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_name VARCHAR(100);
"""

# Step 2: MIGRATE (Deploy V2 - dual write)
class UserService_V2:
    def update_name(self, user_id, full_name):
        first, last = split_name(full_name)
        db.execute("""
            UPDATE users SET 
                name = %s,       -- old column
                first_name = %s, -- new columns
                last_name = %s
            WHERE id = %s
        """, (full_name, first, last, user_id))

# Backfill existing data
"""
UPDATE users SET 
    first_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX(name, ' ', 1),
    last_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX(name, ' ', -1);
"""

# Step 3: CUTOVER (Deploy V3 - read new, write both)
class UserService_V3:
    def get_name(self, user):
        if FeatureFlag.is_enabled('use_split_name'):
            return f"{user.first_name} {user.last_name}"
        return user.name
    
    def update_name(self, user_id, full_name):
        first, last = split_name(full_name)
        db.execute("""
            UPDATE users SET 
                name = %s,
                first_name = %s,
                last_name = %s
            WHERE id = %s
        """, (full_name, first, last, user_id))

# Step 4: CONTRACT (Deploy V4 - remove old)
"""
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN name;
"""
```

## Key Principles

1. **Never break old app versions** - both schemas work simultaneously
2. **Validate before cutover** - verify data integrity thoroughly  
3. **Gradual rollout** - use feature flags for controlled cutover
4. **Wait before CONTRACT** - keep rollback option open 24-48h
5. **Monitor everything** - errors, latency, data consistency

This approach trades simplicity for safety, essential for production systems requiring high availability.

# Structured Logging System with Context Propagation

I'll implement a comprehensive logging system with all enterprise features.

## Complete Implementation

```typescript
// types.ts
export enum LogLevel {
  DEBUG = 0,
  INFO = 1,
  WARN = 2,
  ERROR = 3,
  FATAL = 4,
}

export interface LogContext {
  correlationId?: string;
  userId?: string;
  sessionId?: string;
  requestId?: string;
  traceId?: string;
  spanId?: string;
  component?: string;
  environment?: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export interface LogEntry {
  timestamp: string;
  level: LogLevel;
  message: string;
  context: LogContext;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  error?: {
    name: string;
    message: string;
    stack?: string;
    cause?: any;
  };
}

export interface RedactionRule {
  pattern: RegExp;
  replacement: string;
}

export interface SamplingConfig {
  enabled: boolean;
  rate: number; // 0-1, percentage of logs to keep
  excludeLevels?: LogLevel[]; // Levels to never sample
}

export interface RetentionPolicy {
  maxAge?: number; // milliseconds
  maxSize?: number; // bytes
  maxFiles?: number;
  compression?: boolean;
}

export interface LoggerConfig {
  level: LogLevel;
  context?: Partial<LogContext>;
  redactionRules?: RedactionRule[];
  sampling?: SamplingConfig;
  retention?: RetentionPolicy;
  transports?: LogTransport[];
  asyncLogging?: boolean;
  bufferSize?: number;
}

export interface LogTransport {
  name: string;
  minLevel: LogLevel;
  write(entry: LogEntry): Promise<void> | void;
  flush?(): Promise<void>;
  close?(): Promise<void>;
}

// redactor.ts
export class Redactor {
  private rules: RedactionRule[];

  constructor(customRules: RedactionRule[] = []) {
    this.rules = [
      // Default redaction rules
      {
        pattern: /password["\s:=]+([^\s,"'}]+)/gi,
        replacement: 'password="[REDACTED]"',
      },
      {
        pattern: /api[_-]?key["\s:=]+([^\s,"'}]+)/gi,
        replacement: 'api_key="[REDACTED]"',
      },
      {
        pattern: /bearer\s+([^\s,"'}]+)/gi,
        replacement: 'bearer [REDACTED]',
      },
      {
        pattern: /\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/g, // SSN
        replacement: 'XXX-XX-XXXX',
      },
      {
        pattern: /\b\d{4}[- ]?\d{4}[- ]?\d{4}[- ]?\d{4}\b/g, // Credit card
        replacement: 'XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX',
      },
      {
        pattern: /"email"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/gi,
        replacement: '"email":"[REDACTED]"',
      },
      ...customRules,
    ];
  }

  redact(data: any): any {
    if (typeof data === 'string') {
      return this.redactString(data);
    }

    if (Array.isArray(data)) {
      return data.map((item) => this.redact(item));
    }

    if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
      const redacted: any = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(data)) {
        // Redact sensitive keys entirely
        if (this.isSensitiveKey(key)) {
          redacted[key] = '[REDACTED]';
        } else {
          redacted[key] = this.redact(value);
        }
      }
      return redacted;
    }

    return data;
  }

  private redactString(str: string): string {
    let result = str;
    for (const rule of this.rules) {
      result = result.replace(rule.pattern, rule.replacement);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private isSensitiveKey(key: string): boolean {
    const sensitiveKeys = [
      'password',
      'secret',
      'token',
      'apiKey',
      'api_key',
      'authorization',
      'creditCard',
      'ssn',
      'privateKey',
    ];
    const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();
    return sensitiveKeys.some((sensitive) => lowerKey.includes(sensitive));
  }
}

// sampler.ts
export class LogSampler {
  private config: SamplingConfig;
  private counter = 0;

  constructor(config: SamplingConfig) {
    this.config = config;
  }

  shouldLog(level: LogLevel): boolean {
    if (!this.config.enabled) {
      return true;
    }

    // Never sample certain levels (e.g., ERROR, FATAL)
    if (this.config.excludeLevels?.includes(level)) {
      return true;
    }

    // Deterministic sampling based on rate
    this.counter++;
    const threshold = Math.floor(1 / this.config.rate);
    return this.counter % threshold === 0;
  }

  updateRate(rate: number): void {
    this.config.rate = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rate));
  }
}

// context.ts
export class LogContext {
  private static storage = new Map<string, LogContext>();
  private context: Map<string, any>;

  constructor(initialContext: Record<string, any> = {}) {
    this.context = new Map(Object.entries(initialContext));
  }

  static current(): LogContext {
    const id = this.getCurrentContextId();
    if (!this.storage.has(id)) {
      this.storage.set(id, new LogContext());
    }
    return this.storage.get(id)!;
  }

  static run<T>(context: Record<string, any>, fn: () => T): T {
    const id = this.generateContextId();
    const ctx = new LogContext(context);
    this.storage.set(id, ctx);

    try {
      return fn();
    } finally {
      this.storage.delete(id);
    }
  }

  set(key: string, value: any): void {
    this.context.set(key, value);
  }

  get(key: string): any {
    return this.context.get(key);
  }

  getAll(): Record<string, any> {
    return Object.fromEntries(this.context);
  }

  merge(context: Record<string, any>): void {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(context)) {
      this.context.set(key, value);
    }
  }

  private static getCurrentContextId(): string {
    // In Node.js, use AsyncLocalStorage for proper context propagation
    // For this example, we'll use a simple approach
    return 'global';
  }

  private static generateContextId(): string {
    return `ctx-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
  }
}

// transports/console-transport.ts
export class ConsoleTransport implements LogTransport {
  name = 'console';
  minLevel: LogLevel;
  private colors: boolean;

  constructor(minLevel: LogLevel = LogLevel.DEBUG, colors = true) {
    this.minLevel = minLevel;
    this.colors = colors;
  }

  write(entry: LogEntry): void {
    const formatted = this.format(entry);
    const output = this.colors ? this.colorize(formatted, entry.level) : formatted;

    if (entry.level >= LogLevel.ERROR) {
      console.error(output);
    } else {
      console.log(output);
    }
  }

  private format(entry: LogEntry): string {
    const { timestamp, level, message, context, metadata, error } = entry;
    const parts = [
      timestamp,
      `[${LogLevel[level]}]`,
      context.correlationId ? `[${context.correlationId}]` : '',
      message,
    ];

    if (Object.keys(metadata || {}).length > 0) {
      parts.push(JSON.stringify(metadata));
    }

    if (error) {
      parts.push(`\n${error.stack || error.message}`);
    }

    return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  }

  private colorize(text: string, level: LogLevel): string {
    const colors = {
      [LogLevel.DEBUG]: '\x1b[36m', // Cyan
      [LogLevel.INFO]: '\x1b[32m', // Green
      [LogLevel.WARN]: '\x1b[33m', // Yellow
      [LogLevel.ERROR]: '\x1b[31m', // Red
      [LogLevel.FATAL]: '\x1b[35m', // Magenta
    };

    const reset = '\x1b[0m';
    return `${colors[level]}${text}${reset}`;
  }
}

// transports/file-transport.ts
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';

export class FileTransport implements LogTransport {
  name = 'file';
  minLevel: LogLevel;
  private filePath: string;
  private retention: RetentionPolicy;
  private writeStream: fs.WriteStream | null = null;
  private currentSize = 0;
  private rotationIndex = 0;

  constructor(
    filePath: string,
    minLevel: LogLevel = LogLevel.INFO,
    retention: RetentionPolicy = {}
  ) {
    this.minLevel = minLevel;
    this.filePath = filePath;
    this.retention = {
      maxSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB default
      maxFiles: 5,
      compression: true,
      ...retention,
    };

    this.initialize();
    this.startRetentionCleanup();
  }

  private initialize(): void {
    const dir = path.dirname(this.filePath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    }

    if (fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) {
      const stats = fs.statSync(this.filePath);
      this.currentSize = stats.size;
    }

    this.writeStream = fs.createWriteStream(this.filePath, { flags: 'a' });
  }

  async write(entry: LogEntry): Promise<void> {
    const line = JSON.stringify(entry) + '\n';
    const size = Buffer.byteLength(line);

    if (this.shouldRotate(size)) {
      await this.rotate();
    }

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.writeStream!.write(line, (err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else {
          this.currentSize += size;
          resolve();
        }
      });
    });
  }

  private shouldRotate(nextSize: number): boolean {
    if (!this.retention.maxSize) return false;
    return this.currentSize + nextSize > this.retention.maxSize;
  }

  private async rotate(): Promise<void> {
    await this.flush();
    this.writeStream?.close();

    this.rotationIndex++;
    const rotatedPath = `${this.filePath}.${this.rotationIndex}`;

    fs.renameSync(this.filePath, rotatedPath);

    if (this.retention.compression) {
      await this.compressFile(rotatedPath);
    }

    this.currentSize = 0;
    this.writeStream = fs.createWriteStream(this.filePath, { flags: 'a' });

    await this.cleanupOldFiles();
  }

  private async compressFile(filePath: string): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const gzip = zlib.createGzip();
      const input = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
      const output = fs.createWriteStream(`${filePath}.gz`);

      input
        .pipe(gzip)
        .pipe(output)
        .on('finish', () => {
          fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
          resolve();
        })
        .on('error', reject);
    });
  }

  private async cleanupOldFiles(): Promise<void> {
    const dir = path.dirname(this.filePath);
    const baseName = path.basename(this.filePath);
    const files = fs
      .readdirSync(dir)
      .filter((f) => f.startsWith(baseName) && f !== baseName)
      .map((f) => ({
        name: f,
        path: path.join(dir, f),
        stats: fs.statSync(path.join(dir, f)),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.stats.mtime.getTime() - a.stats.mtime.getTime());

    // Remove files beyond maxFiles
    if (this.retention.maxFiles) {
      files.slice(this.retention.maxFiles).forEach((file) => {
        fs.unlinkSync(file.path);
      });
    }

    // Remove files older than maxAge
    if (this.retention.maxAge) {
      const cutoff = Date.now() - this.retention.maxAge;
      files
        .filter((file) => file.stats.mtime.getTime() < cutoff)
        .forEach((file) => {
          fs.unlinkSync(file.path);
        });
    }
  }

  private startRetentionCleanup(): void {
    // Run cleanup every hour
    setInterval(() => {
      this.cleanupOldFiles();
    }, 60 * 60 * 1000);
  }

  async flush(): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (this.writeStream) {
        this.writeStream.once('drain', resolve);
      } else {
        resolve();
      }
    });
  }

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    await this.flush();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (this.writeStream) {
        this.writeStream.close(() => resolve());
      } else {
        resolve();
      }
    });
  }
}

export class HttpTransport implements LogTransport {
  name = 'http';
  minLevel: LogLevel;
  private endpoint: string;
  private batchSize: number;
  private flushInterval: number;
  private buffer: LogEntry[] = [];
  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

  constructor(
    endpoint: string,
    minLevel: LogLevel = LogLevel.INFO,
    options: { batchSize?: number; flushInterval?: number } = {}
  ) {
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
    this.minLevel = minLevel;
    this.batchSize = options.batchSize || 100;
    this.flushInterval = options.flushInterval || 5000;

    this.startAutoFlush();
  }

  async write(entry: LogEntry): Promise<void> {
    this.buffer.push(entry);

    if (this.buffer.length >= this.batchSize) {
      await this.flush();
    }
  }

  async flush(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.buffer.length === 0) return;

    const entries = [...this.buffer];
    this.buffer = [];

    try {
      const response = await fetch(this.endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ logs: entries }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.error(`Failed to send logs: ${response.statusText}`);
        // Re-add to buffer or implement retry logic
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error sending logs:', error);
      // Re-add to buffer or implement retry logic
    }
  }

  private startAutoFlush(): void {
    this.timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.flush();
    }, this.flushInterval);
  }

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.timer) {
      clearInterval(this.timer);
    }
    await this.flush();
  }
}

export class Logger {
  private config: LoggerConfig;
  private redactor: Redactor;
  private sampler: LogSampler;
  private logBuffer: LogEntry[] = [];
  private flushTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

  constructor(config: Partial<LoggerConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = {
      level: LogLevel.INFO,
      asyncLogging: true,
      bufferSize: 1000,
      sampling: { enabled: false, rate: 1 },
      ...config,
    };

    this.redactor = new Redactor(this.config.redactionRules);
    this.sampler = new LogSampler(this.config.sampling!);

    if (this.config.asyncLogging) {
      this.startAutoFlush();
    }
  }

  debug(message: string, metadata?: Record<string, any>): void {
    this.log(LogLevel.DEBUG, message, metadata);
  }

  info(message: string, metadata?: Record<string, any>): void {
    this.log(LogLevel.INFO, message, metadata);
  }

  warn(message: string, metadata?: Record<string, any>): void {
    this.log(LogLevel.WARN, message, metadata);
  }

  error(message: string, error?: Error, metadata?: Record<string, any>): void {
    this.log(LogLevel.ERROR, message, metadata, error);
  }

  fatal(message: string, error?: Error, metadata?: Record<string, any>): void {
    this.log(LogLevel.FATAL, message, metadata, error);
  }

  private log(
    level: LogLevel,
    message: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, any>,
    error?: Error
  ): void {
    // Check log level
    if (level < this.config.level) {
      return;
    }

    // Check sampling
    if (!this.sampler.shouldLog(level)) {
      return;
    }

    // Build log entry
    const entry = this.buildLogEntry(level, message, metadata, error);

    // Async or sync logging
    if (this.config.asyncLogging) {
      this.logBuffer.push(entry);
      if (this.logBuffer.length >= this.config.bufferSize!) {
        this.flush();
      }
    } else {
      this.writeToTransports(entry);
    }
  }

  private buildLogEntry(
    level: LogLevel,
    message: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, any>,
    error?: Error
  ): LogEntry {
    const contextData = LogContext.current().getAll();
    const mergedContext = {
      ...this.config.context,
      ...contextData,
    };

    const entry: LogEntry = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      level,
      message: this.redactor.redact(message),
      context: mergedContext,
    };

    if (metadata) {
      entry.metadata = this.redactor.redact(metadata);
    }

    if (error) {
      entry.error = {
        name: error.name,
        message: this.redactor.redact(error.message),
        stack: error.stack,
        cause: error.cause,
      };
    }

    return entry;
  }

  private writeToTransports(entry: LogEntry): void {
    const transports = this.config.transports || [];
    for (const transport of transports) {
      if (entry.level >= transport.minLevel) {
        try {
          const result = transport.write(entry);
          if (result instanceof Promise) {
            result.catch((err) => {
              console.error(`Transport ${transport.name} error:`, err);
            });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Transport ${transport.name} error:`, err);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private startAutoFlush(): void {
    this.flushTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if (this.logBuffer.length > 0) {
        this.flush();
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  flush(): void {
    const entries = [...this.logBuffer];
    this.logBuffer = [];

    for (const entry of entries) {
      this.writeToTransports(entry);
    }
  }

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.flushTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.flushTimer);
    }

    this.flush();

    const transports = this.config.transports || [];
    await Promise.all(
      transports.map((t) => t.close?.()).filter((p): p is Promise<void> => !!p)
    );
  }

  child(context: Partial<LogContext>): Logger {
    return new Logger({
      ...this.config,
      context: {
        ...this.config.context,
        ...context,
      },
    });
  }
}

import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export function correlationMiddleware(logger: Logger) {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const correlationId = req.headers['x-correlation-id'] as string || uuidv4();
    const requestId = uuidv4();

    // Set response header
    res.setHeader('X-Correlation-ID', correlationId);
    res.setHeader('X-Request-ID', requestId);

    // Create context for this request
    const context = {
      correlationId,
      requestId,
      method: req.method,
      path: req.path,
      userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'],
      ip: req.ip,
    };

    // Run in context
    LogContext.run(context, () => {
      // Log request
      logger.info('Request started', {
        method: req.method,
        path: req.path,
        query: req.query,
      });

      // Log response
      res.on('finish', () => {
        logger.info('Request completed', {
          statusCode: res.statusCode,
          duration: Date.now() - Date.parse(req.headers['x-request-time'] as string),
        });
      });

      next();
    });
  };
}
```

```swift
// FeatureFlagManager.swift
class FeatureFlagManager {
    static let shared = FeatureFlagManager()
    
    private let userDefaults = UserDefaults.standard
    private let networkService: NetworkService
    private var memoryCache: [String: FeatureConfig] = [:]
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.app.featureflags")
    
    // Cache keys
    private let cachePrefix = "feature_flag_"
    private let lastFetchKey = "feature_flags_last_fetch"
    private let cacheExpirationSeconds: TimeInterval = 3600 // 1 hour
    
    private init(networkService: NetworkService = .shared) {
        self.networkService = networkService
        loadCachedFlags()
    }
    
    // MARK: - Main API
    
    func isEnabled(_ feature: Feature, userId: String? = nil) -> Bool {
        return queue.sync {
            // 1. Check kill switch first
            if isKillSwitchActive(feature) {
                logDecision(feature, decision: false, reason: "kill_switch")
                return false
            }
            
            // 2. Check memory cache
            if let config = memoryCache[feature.rawValue] {
                let enabled = evaluateConfig(config, feature: feature, userId: userId)
                logDecision(feature, decision: enabled, reason: "memory_cache")
                return enabled
            }
            
            // 3. Check persistent cache
            if let config = loadFromCache(feature) {
                memoryCache[feature.rawValue] = config
                let enabled = evaluateConfig(config, feature: feature, userId: userId)
                logDecision(feature, decision: enabled, reason: "disk_cache")
                return enabled
            }
            
            // 4. Check if offline - use offline default
            if !networkService.isReachable {
                logDecision(feature, decision: feature.offlineDefault, reason: "offline_default")
                return feature.offlineDefault
            }
            
            // 5. Use hardcoded default
            logDecision(feature, decision: feature.defaultValue, reason: "hardcoded_default")
            return feature.defaultValue
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Fetch from Server
    
    func fetchFlags(completion: ((Result<Void, Error>) -> Void)? = nil) {
        guard !isRecentlyFetched() else {
            completion?(.success(()))
            return
        }
        
        networkService.fetchFeatureFlags { [weak self] result in
            switch result {
            case .success(let flags):
                self?.processFlags(flags)
                self?.markFetchTime()
                completion?(.success(()))
                
            case .failure(let error):
                // Don't overwrite cache on failure
                print("Failed to fetch flags: \(error)")
                completion?(.failure(error))
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Kill Switch
    
    private func isKillSwitchActive(_ feature: Feature) -> Bool {
        let killSwitchKey = "kill_switch_\(feature.rawValue)"
        
        // Check server-provided kill switch
        if let config = memoryCache[feature.rawValue],
           config.killSwitch {
            return true
        }
        
        // Check local override (for emergency manual disable)
        return userDefaults.bool(forKey: killSwitchKey)
    }
    
    func activateKillSwitch(_ feature: Feature) {
        let killSwitchKey = "kill_switch_\(feature.rawValue)"
        userDefaults.set(true, forKey: killSwitchKey)
        NotificationCenter.default.post(
            name: .featureFlagDidChange,
            object: feature.rawValue
        )
    }
    
    // MARK: - Evaluation Logic
    
    private func evaluateConfig(
        _ config: FeatureConfig,
        feature: Feature,
        userId: String?
    ) -> Bool {
        // Kill switch check
        if config.killSwitch {
            return false
        }
        
        // Full rollout
        if config.rolloutPercentage >= 100 {
            return config.enabled
        }
        
        // Staged rollout based on user ID
        guard let userId = userId ?? getCurrentUserId() else {
            return feature.defaultValue
        }
        
        // Consistent hashing for user bucketing
        let bucket = userBucket(userId: userId, feature: feature)
        let isInRollout = bucket < config.rolloutPercentage
        
        return config.enabled && isInRollout
    }
    
    private func userBucket(userId: String, feature: Feature) -> Int {
        let seed = "\(userId)_\(feature.rawValue)"
        let hash = seed.djb2hash
        return hash % 100
    }
    
    // MARK: - Caching
    
    private func loadFromCache(_ feature: Feature) -> FeatureConfig? {
        let key = cachePrefix + feature.rawValue
        guard let data = userDefaults.data(forKey: key),
              let config = try? JSONDecoder().decode(FeatureConfig.self, from: data),
              !config.isExpired(expirationSeconds: cacheExpirationSeconds) else {
            return nil
        }
        return config
    }
    
    private func saveToCache(_ feature: Feature, config: FeatureConfig) {
        let key = cachePrefix + feature.rawValue
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(config) {
            userDefaults.set(data, forKey: key)
        }
    }
    
    private func loadCachedFlags() {
        queue.async {
            for feature in Feature.allCases {
                if let config = self.loadFromCache(feature) {
                    self.memoryCache[feature.rawValue] = config
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    private func processFlags(_ flags: [String: FeatureConfig]) {
        queue.async {
            for (key, config) in flags {
                self.memoryCache[key] = config
                if let feature = Feature(rawValue: key) {
                    self.saveToCache(feature, config: config)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    private func isRecentlyFetched() -> Bool {
        guard let lastFetch = userDefaults.object(forKey: lastFetchKey) as? Date else {
            return false
        }
        return Date().timeIntervalSince(lastFetch) < cacheExpirationSeconds
    }
    
    private func markFetchTime() {
        userDefaults.set(Date(), forKey: lastFetchKey)
    }
    
    private func getCurrentUserId() -> String? {
        // Get from auth service or device ID
        return AuthService.shared.userId ?? UIDevice.current.identifierForVendor?.uuidString
    }
    
    private func logDecision(_ feature: Feature, decision: Bool, reason: String) {
        Analytics.log(event: "feature_flag_evaluated", properties: [
            "feature": feature.rawValue,
            "enabled": decision,
            "reason": reason
        ])
    }
}
```
